description: Staying at the heart of Istanbul in a smart and cozy flat, 7/24 access to cosmopolitan city life, shopping dining and entertainment of Istanbul

reviews.text:
While there were some positive aspects, there were also several issues. The house looks exactly like the pictures, and it has a good amount of space, which was nice. It's close to Taksim, and we appreciated the ability to cook, do laundry for free, and watch Netflix. However, we were disappointed with the cleanliness. Despite paying a cleaning fee, we found oily fingerprints on the walls and remote controls, and almost all the kitchen utilities were dirty—there was even dirty water left in the coffeepot and refrigerator.
As for the location, though it’s convenient, we felt uncomfortable as most of the people in the neighborhood seemed to be foreigners, cause they for sure not Turkish at all. Even as a foreigner and Turkish couple ourselves, we felt uneasy because people kept staring at us while we walked to and from Taksim or back home. The neighborhood also felt a bit suspicious, and someone kept opening our trash bags. Also some neighbors from street keep doing phone call right out

We recently stayed at John's Airbnb and had an excellent experience. The place was exactly as shown in the pictures—very clean, tidy, cozy, and very comfortable. John was a responsive and polite host, making the stay even more pleasant. The only thing I should mention is that there were four of us, all adults. The sofa bed might not be as spacious as some would expect, but we were okay with it. If you're looking for a place to stay with peace of mind, this is the spot. Highly recommended!

We really liked the apartment, which is located in the heart of Istanbul. The apartment has everything for a comfortable stay, it is clean and tidy. Can is very attentive and responds quickly. We recommend and we will definitely be back.
Great stay! The apartment was clean and comfortable, and Can was a very kind and helpful host. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Very comfortable everything was provided place was central walkable and the host was so nice thanks again would highly recommend

description: 10 Steps to the Yusufpaşa Tram | Luxury, Modern Apartment” with 3 air conditioners

reviews.text: Bright, clean and well-modernised 2 bedroom apartment with elevator access. Akin was very communicative from the moment we placed the booking. His 'how to reach' videos are very helpful. He frequently messaged to ensure everything was ok both before and during our stay. The location is perfect for visitors to Istanbul being only 50 metres from the nearest tram stop, and one block from Aksaray metro station and the current Havaist airport bus terminus. We stayed in December but the apartment is well heated (and has a.c. units in each room for the warmer season!) This place is also excellent value for money. Thank you again Akin!!

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The apartment was exactly as described — modern, very clean, and well maintained. It was spacious enough for our family and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The location was excellent, especially being close to public transport, which made it easy for us to explore the city. Despite being centrally located, the area felt safe and convenient for families.
The host was responsive, helpful, and made the check-in process very smooth. Any questions we had were answered quickly, which made our trip stress-free.
Overall, we truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to families visiting Istanbul. We would happily stay here again.

Really happy with this one. The apartment was very clean and and exactly as described, and Murat made everything effortless — clear instructions ahead of time, quick to respond, and genuinely welcoming. The location was convenient and easy to get around from. For the price, it's hard to beat. Highly recommend, and thanks again for having us!

We had such a wonderful experience during our stay at this vacation home! The house was spotless and beautifully decorated, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for our relaxing trip. The kitchen was generously stocked with everything we needed, the beds were incredibly comfortable, and the outdoor space was truly delightful.
The location was wonderfully serene and peaceful, yet conveniently close to shops, restaurants, and attractions, which made our stay even more enjoyable. Our host was exceptionally friendly and responsive, ensuring we had everything we could possibly need to feel at home. We wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone seeking a comfortable and stress-free getaway. We would definitely return!

Akın's apartment exceeded all our expectations. The location is absolutely perfect - convenient to everything we wanted to see and do. Akın was incredibly helpful throughout our entire stay, responding to messages immediately and going above and beyond to ensure we had everything we needed.
The apartment itself was spotless, exactly as described, and had all the amenities we could ask for. Everything was perfect from check-in to check-out. We thoroughly enjoyed our time there and felt completely at home.
Akın is a wonderful host who truly cares about his guests' experience. We would definitely stay here again and recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Thank you for such a memorable stay!

description:
The apartment is located in the lively and touristic historical Cihangir area, within walking distance to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street and many restaurants, bars, souvenir shops and supermarkets.
The historic peninsula (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, Grand Bazaar and more) is only a few minutes away on foot or by tram.
There is also a pier that will take you to the Bosphorus or the Islands by boat, just a 15-minute walk from the apartment!

reviews.text:
The location was easy to find, the apartment is on the 5th floor with spiral staircase, so pretty difficult to take your luggage up specially if you’re travelling as a family. There is no lift. You can hear the people walking on the top floor as if they are in your apartment, we found lubricant gel and dirty tissues from the previous guests in the bedroom. The bathroom sink was blocked, plates with food were left in the kitchen cupboard and the dishwasher stuck as if someone threw up in there.
The communication from the host is super fast, and instructions to get in were clear.
I have stayed in far better accommodations for way less. I wouldn’t recommend this accommodation unless personal hygiene is no priority.

I stayed for 1 month and while the location was very central and the apartment was as pictured, I had many issues during my stay. During my stay the wifi stopped working and it took several maintenance visits to repair it - almost a week. The AC stopped working too. The coffee maker was broken upon arrival, and the kitchen ceiling started leaking at the end of my stay. When it rains, water leaks in through the patio door so my things sitting near that door got soaked. The bed was so uncomfortable that I had back and neck pain all month. The unit is poorly stocked for a long term stay. There were only 4 hangers, no skillet (host brought one), one dull knife, no cutting board, a washer but no drying rack. There is also not a refrigerator as listed, only a minifridge. The location is excellent, I loved the Cihangir neighborhood. Just know that there are A TON of stray cats and poop everywhere. Unfortunately because of the many issues I would not recommend this place.

It was a very cozy and comfortable stay. The apartment is beautiful and clean, with thoughtful touches like extra pillows and everything needed.
Co-host Rumeysa was always responsive and helpful, and accommodated an early check-in. The location is superb — you can walk almost everywhere.
Would happily stay here again. Thank you for a lovely stay! 🌸

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartment. The location is amazing—although it’s very close to the main street, which is usually busy and loud, the apartment itself felt very private and calm. It was clean, comfortable, and well-kept. The landlord was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. We stayed for two weeks, and when I asked to change the towels after the first week, it was arranged the very next day without any problem. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended!

The apartment is very nice and clean. The neighborhood is amazing, quiet and nice, we had zero issues with noise. It was amazing to wake up in the morning and have a coffee on the balcony. We had to extend the stay 3 times and the host was very responsive and kind. We have also locked ourselves out and the host immediately came and helped us get inside the apartment. Had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend

description: Hello! I'm Mehmet. I would be happy to host you in this comfortable place, which is very close to Taksim and Istiklal Street. Enjoy being in the heart of the city and know that I will enjoy serving you in the best way possible. I'm here to meet your needs throughout your stay. I can't wait to host you!

reviews.text:
I had an overall good stay here and I think it’s a good option for a few days in Istanbul. The apartment is spacious, the AC and fridge worked well, and although it’s not right in the main tourist area, many central places are within walking distance. The host was very kind, responsive, and always willing to help.
A few things to keep in mind: the neighborhood can be quite noisy, and at times there were unpleasant smells coming from the street, apparently from animals urinating nearby. The water supply was also interrupted several times during my stay, though this seemed outside the host’s control. The bathroom has no shower screen or separate shower area, so the whole floor gets wet and you have to push the water toward the drain after showering.
Despite these inconveniences, the apartment itself was comfortable and the host was excellent!!

Good location close to the subway and the city center. The apartment is downhill from Taksim Square, so the walk back involves a steep climb. The host responds quickly and there are affordable cafes nearby. The bathroom has no shower cabin, so water spreads across the floor and doesn’t drain well (possibly due to the floor angle), making it hard to remove after showering, although it dries by morning. The bed is a bit short - guests taller than 175 cm may find their feet hanging off. Overall, it offers reasonable value for the price, especially if you’re a side sleeper

The place is located near Taksim Square, so it was very nice. The neighborhood was quiet. The place matched the photos and was very, very clean and well prepared. Overall, I really liked the stay for what I had to pay. A few things to consider: 1. Boiler is installed on the room’s wall so it makes a continuous noise. 2. Bathroom is a wet bathroom, meaning the floor gets wet when you take a shower (uncommon to western people).

I stayed at the apartment for about a week and very much enjoyed my stay. The room was very clean and had everything I needed. The apartment is very close to the city center and there are many shops, restaurants and transport options nearby. At the same the apartment is located on a very quiet street, so, combined with a very comfotable bed, you will be able to have a great rest after a day of walking in the city :) Mehmet is a wonderful host, very outgoing and ready to help with anything, so you will be in good hands there. 100% recommend!

Tuvaletin kapağı kırıktı, pencere kırıktı, oda temiz sayılmazdı, bardak sıkıntısı vardı iki taneydi sadece ve çok küçüklerdi. Terlikler çok kötüydü. Televizyon kumandasının pili bitmişti çalışmıyordu. Banyo da maalesef hiç iyi değildi. Konumu gayet iyi yerdeydi ve rahat bulduk. Ev sahibi iyi ilgilendi. Kısa süre için kalınabilir ama 2 günü geçecekse pek tavsiye etmem.

description: This flat is in a very central point of Istanbul. It is adjacent to Istanbul Medical University (ÇAPA) and Bezmi Alem University. Beyazıt Square is 15 minutes, Aksaray is 10 minutes, Laleli is 12 minutes away, Sultanahmet Square and Mosque is 20 minutes away, Hagia Sophia is 20 minutes away, Grand Bazaar is 20 minutes away, Eminönü is 25 minutes away from our flat. There are many restaurants, markets and cafes within a few minutes walking distance. Public transport stops are just 5 minutes.

reviews.text:
I had a great stay at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as shown in the photos — clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The host was very polite, communication was easy, and he was always responsive.
The only downsides were the location, which is a bit far from most of the main places you’d want to visit in Istanbul, and the stairs leading to the apartment. The stairs are quite steep, which can make it difficult for anyone with a baby ( which was my case ) ,luggage, or mobility concerns.
Overall, it was still a pleasant stay, and I appreciate the host’s hospitality.

Bahar and her husband are very responsive and replied to all my requests and questions within minutes. I even locked myself out of the house and they came within 5 minutes to help me. The check in was easy and directions are very clear. The home is very clean and looks exactly like the photos. We stayed for over 3 weeks and it really felt like home. I cook most nights and the home has everything you need to prepare dinners. Transportation is easy with the metro just a few minutes walk. Capa is a very lively but very safe neighborhood with lots of wonderful restaurants and tea shops right across the Main Street. It was a quiet neighborhood and we were able to usually find close parking. Loved it so much we will definitely stay again when we return to Istanbul.

The place is exactly as described and loaded with everything that you could possibly think of and went above and beyond to make sure you feel at home, spotless clean, perfect location close to the center of Istanbul were you could get transportation to anywhere around the city, a lot of great restaurants around here that you really get overwhelmed with options and open till late, Hosts got us cover in everything we needed and very responsive and respectful, Thanks to both Şaban and Bahar for the great hospitality and swiftly fixing the kitchen faucet in time, we liked the place and the Hosts so much that we asked to extend our stay.

Bahar and Saban were very helpful with a quick response to our messages since we booked. Check in was very easy. The house was very clean and match the photos. Everything we needed was also available.
The location of the apartment is excellent, everything is nearby public transport (the tram-station and the bus station ) supermarkets and restaurants.
The surroundings were quiet and safe.
We enjoyed our stay and we will come again in our next visit to Istanbul

Really nice apartment, very clean and ordered. Kitchen stuff for cooking, very comfortable bed. Perfect location with public transport and next to a main avenue with lots of life. Communication with the hosts easy and fast. Thanks for everything!

description: Our apartment has been decorated taking into account the latest luxury trends and standards. Thanks to our stylish decor, you can feel at home and enjoy a pleasant vacation. Located right in the heart of Istanbul, this apartment offers easy access to everywhere thanks to its great location. We continue to share your most beautiful moments with you in this lovely apartment. All rooms in our apartment have air conditioning. We care a lot about the comfort and convenience of our esteemed guests.

reviews.text: Lovely airy, clean apartment close to shops, supermarket and places to eat. Apartment is just like the pictures comfortable, homely and secure. Kitchen has all that you need. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and Funda was always friendly and responsive whenever contacted. Would definitely stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. It was even more spacious than we thought. Nice, cozy interior, all the required amenities in place, a beautiful balcony and view from it. Our neighbors were a little too noisy at night but you can't blame the owners for that. Just note that the walls don't seem to be thick enough to protect from the noise. Our main contact person was Şahin bey who was very responsive, understanding and friendly. We had a small issue with the water tap in the kitchen upon our arrival and it was fixed swiftly the next day.
Overall, it was a pleasant stay and we would love to return again. Just a small recommendation that cleaning could be done a little more thoroughly after previous guests. Apart from that, everything was just fine. Thank you!

reviews.text:
Our family really liked this apartment, the check-in and stay were comfortable. The apartment has a modern renovation and we were pleased with the amount of household appliances. The residential complex has a swimming pool, security and its own parking.
We were also pleased with the convenient location next to the metro and overall a pleasant area without huge queues of tourists

Spacious, well-equipped place in a great location. Everything you need is nearby—pharmacy, public transport, grocery store, restaurants, and bakery. There’s also a nice park just a 3-minute walk away, perfect for families. Parking is a big plus.
The host is proactive, responds quickly, and was very supportive—even though we arrived late in the evening and had a few small requests.
Highly recommend, and I’d definitely stay here again when in Istanbul.

I had a wonderful two-week stay here. The home was exceptionally clean, very well equipped, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The host was great and made the experience smooth and pleasant. I would be more than happy to stay here again!

description: We are Mayer Property Mngmt company with over 120 apts in our portfolio. We are loc at the heart of city, Taxim and has easy access to all attractions and hip rests & cafes. reviews.text: The apartment is located very close to İstiklal, less than 10 minutes away. It's a generally quiet street since it isn't on the main road. The apartment has everything described and, should you stay more than a week, there is complementary cleaning. The internet was also fast enough for me to telework. I would stay here again.

We’ve been there for 15 minutes and then left… It was disgusting. A lot of mold in the bathroom (it’s Istanbul, i get it, but it was lots of it), stains all over the walls, hair and stains on the beds, broken furniture, garbage on the furniture, dust, sticky floors…
To be fair, Ilkan offered to spend the night in the apartment upstairs and to clean our flat the next day, but we weren’t sure it would be clean there. In general through the communication Ilkan was not attentive, his instructions was unsure, opening the apartment was a quest.
In the end Ilkan offered returning money for 5 days of 7 referring to their non-existent “policy”, but thanks to Airbnb support I returned all of the money.
I do not recommend this apartment.
I had a great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host was friendly and helpful. I would definitely recommend it!

We had an overall lovely stay at the apartment, and Ilkan even allowed us to extend our stay when we needed.
The apartment was a great stay at a good location. The shower was my favourite part of the stay.
The kitchen tap was loose so we had to use it carefully in case it broke. Towel railing or a hook in the bathroom would be convenient.
Place is nice and cosy. Clean and necessary amenities are there as listed. Walking distance to Istiklal street (and to Galata tower if you are like me and you like walking :))

description:
Exploring Istanbul couldn’t be easier!

Lovely apartment in the heart of the city. The location is great, very central and close to a supermarket, many restaurants, and bars.
Taksim square, bus and metro stations are just 2 minutes away on foot.
There are many foreigners and ex-pats in the neighborhood as well as locals.
There is a 24-hour paid parking right next to the building.

This is the center where it all happens yet you will feel very safe and comfortable in the area.

reviews.text:
Very nice place! Clean modern and true to the photos. Convenient location. Host was super proactive checking if we need anything daily and accommodating of our requests. Call to prayer can be a bit loud but we didn’t mind.
Highly recommend!

The apartment was well presented and clean. The location was great close to Taksim 3min walk and 2x grocery shops. Kadir was super responsive and checked in with us every morning.
Just on weekend the nighclub can be heard. Overall, good stay at the apartment which was spacious and good value for money.
Kadir was a very helpful host - the property is well located, clean and accurately reflect the images!

The place is super clean. The apartment is newly renovated and furniture is new. They send cleaning service every 4-5 days for longer stays. The location is very convenient 3 minutes walk to Taksim. The host is super responsive and caring. We loved the place.

الصراحه انصح فيها شقه مودرن ونضيفه وتستاهل سعرها كل شيء حولك وبعيد عن الازعاج شقه هادئه والضيف متعاون ويستاهل لو ارجع تركيا اجي عنده شقه فخمه Frankly, I recommend it. It is a modern, clean apartment, and it is worth its price. Everything is around you, and it is far from the noise. It is a quiet apartment, and the guests are cooperative. It deserves it. If I return to Türkiye, I will come to his luxurious apartment.

description:
Enjoy a wonderful stay in your tiny apartment in this mansion, one of Kadıköy's historic bay window houses.
the flat is all yours. It has been completely renovated, but you can feel the spirit of this historic mansion with its building entrance, stairs and high ceilings. Even if the apartment is small, the high ceilings always give you a spacious feeling. With its vibrant and central location, everything for groceries, transportation, dining and entertainment will be just a 2-3 minute walk away.

reviews.text: Tuğba hanımın dairelerine 5. seyahatimiz iletişimde hiç bir sorun yaşamadık konumu,temizliği,fiyatı müthiş tek sıkıntı duşakabin kırılmıştı dolayısıyla nemden dolayı böcek sorunu yaşadık ve klima balkona ufak su damlatıyordu harici sıkıntı olmadı balkon daire kadar fiyat performans bir yer gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edilebilir

It was an absolute pleasure staying at Tugbas Airbnb. The location is super central in kadikoy, where you’re only a short walk from great restaurants, markets, shops, and bars. You are also 3 mins from the bus stop, metro stop, taxi stop, dolmuş stop, and the ferry to cross to the European side of the city- so you’re getting a great value without overpaying to be in the super touristic areas.
The home itself is small but perfect for 1 or 2 persons. It has a fridge and a small kitchen along with a bathroom with a hair dryer. Unlike most European Airbnbs where you have to meet the host for the key, this also has a contactless check in which makes it flexible and easy.
You’re staying in a shared building which has many other small Airbnbs like this one. I personally ran into some other guests but was not bothered by them. You can hear them in the hallways sometimes though but for the price you pay it’s an incredible value regardless. I’d love to stay here again!

Peaceful and very cozy apartment right in the center of kadikoy. literally close to everything you need, close to metro/ferry, a walking distance close to the busy streets of kadikoy. Apartment was always warm when outside was cold. Balcony was nice to use when it was sunny, the shower is amazing as well. maybe it’s missing a television only but i didnt feel like i needed it at all. hosts were very nice and friendly, always helpful and responsive, provided me with extra towels and toilet paper when needed, it was a 10/10

The boiler is noisy, water from the shower leaks into the rest of the bathroom, the outlet and floor lamp are broken, the walls of the room are dirty and chipped, the right side of the bed is broken. But the location and view from the balcony are great.

Tuğba Hanım ve Ahmet Bey'e çok teşekkür ederiz, mesajlarımıza hemen dönüş yaptılar.
Ev ile alakalı tek söylebileceğim şey alanın küçük olması ama bu açıkça belirtilmiş bir özellik olarak sunuluyor açıklamada. Sıcak aylarda balkonu da kullanmanın vereceği rahatlıkla daha geniş bir alana yayılabilirsiniz.
Konum olarak çok merkezi bir lokasyonda her yere yürüme mesafesinde, yürümeyi sevmiyorsanız dahi gayet yakınlarda çok opsiyon var.
Sadece birkaç önerim olacak kendilerine:

The place was clean and had all the basic things you needed. The hosts were very responsive and tended to me needs. The ONLY thing that I wish could be better is the internet. I quite enjoyed staying in this Airbnb, and I believe this might be one of the best deals around Aksaray, Laleli Area. As budget hotel goes it was clean, room was quite big and specious, there is small kitchen if one wants to make a quick meal. Overall I felt safe and everything worked as it should !

Good accomodation, clean inside. AC was working, personnel were friendly and helpful. Men at the reception spoke English. Not far from the accomodation was a tram and metro/train stop, easy to reach city centre.

Thank you!

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service and assistance for your concierge needs, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
It was an amazing experience for us to be there. Location is superb and you can easily get wherever you want by walking or taking a bus.
Apartment by itself is located on a last floor and it can be a bit difficult to get inside if you are with heavy luggage but it is not a major thing.
Appartment was mostly clean, with all needed amenities. We even requested a yoga mat and landlord added it immediately.
Visual look from the balcony is reminding some classic french movies, so we felt ourselves main characters there.
Hot water was available and easy configurable, there were some flooding from the bath, but host said that it will be fixed soon.
Overall experience was great. We are happy that it was possible to have such a nice vacation here and I hope we will be back here soon.

The location of this place gets 5 stars! Perfect for walking and getting around. Love the neighbourhood. Lots around to see and do. And beautiful view as others have mentioned.
But this is all. First of all, there are 6 flights of narrow stairs that are so difficult to navigate with suitcases. Do not recommend for those coming with big suitcases. The property itself has so much noise pollution from outside and the curtains are not sufficient so even when the noise stops, you still cannot sleep due to the light- the curtains don’t cover the windows and it’s extremely bright. We had to sleep with earplugs and eye masks. The shower doesn’t have a proper shower head so showering wasn’t great either. The wifi stopped working after our first day unfortunately and the air con wasn’t cooling the space sufficiently either.
Great deal for those who don’t care for sleep or rest and just want to be in a place that’s central with a nice view.

Gorgeous apartment!
A truly unique experience, living on a rooftop with a magnificent view in a great neighborhood! 10/10 recommendation, although the bathroom had some minor issues, especially with the water temperature fluctuating, and overall it wasn't very comfortable. Overall, everything else was in good condition, and the bed and linens were fantastic! Check-in went smoothly, and the owners responded quickly and were helpful via chat.

**English Version (concise):**
If you’re looking for an authentic Istanbul experience, this apartment is an excellent choice! We were the first guests, and our stay exceeded all expectations. Two terraces on opposite sides offer beautiful Galata views and plenty of light, and being on the top floor is a bonus. The interior has a creative layout with modern appliances, so we never lacked anything.
Located in a vibrant, bohemian district, it’s surrounded by great cafés, restaurants, and easy transport to the old city. There’s also a nearby port for water trips. The Wi-Fi (with Ethernet) is sufficient for everyday needs; for higher speeds, host Arif guided us to a nearby café with a 1 Gbps connection. We had a romantic, memorable stay and truly appreciate Arif’s support and friendly communication. Highly recommended!

Arif's place is absolutely perfectly located ! If you wish to discover Istanbul in a few days without too much stress, it's just ideal !
You can literally walk everywhere or take the tramway with Tophane stations being 1-minute walk away.
The neighbourhood is so cool as well, with many bars, cafés and shops all around (everything is uphill though, but that's the whole city's charm !)
As per the flat itself, it's really cozy and comfy, with great views all around. Just note that it's at the top of the building with narrow stairways, but it's so worth the climb !
It can get hot at the end of the day, but it has AC.
So great to have a place feeling like a real home, well equipped and charming rather than a taste-less airbnb. Would totally recommend it !

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Clean, quiet, and convenient location! AC worked well, bed was comfortable, and overall the place got the job done. Be aware this unit is on the 4th floor so may be challenging to bring heavy suitcases up. Good value for your money!

I have stayed in many BnBs in Kadiköy over the past 16 months - this was easily one of my most enjoyable and worthwhile stays!
Owners are very quick to respond and assist, the place is immaculately clean. It's fairly new, so the bathroom in particular does not have some of the typical issues of the area!
Kitchen worked wonderfully, area is pretty quiet, no large bars or noise from street (except for Fenerbahce stadium on match day, but that's fun!).
Only tiny problem was that the default WiFi was pretty bad/didn't work - but the issues was solved almost immediately by swiftly making a different network available to me!
5/5 experience, especially for the very good price!

The flat was very clean, fully equipped and cozy. The location was great and "Feeling Home" can be totally described for this place. If you'll stay in Istanbul Kadıköy this can be one of the best places to rent.
I recommend everyone this flat.

Well located, clean and tidy apartment. Easy walking distance from the bus station.
Great communication with Hakan and Irem.

This apartment has all you need. It's quiet for the very lively and noisy Kadikoy, so you're likely to sleep well Check in was fully flexible and easy. Ultra cleaning comfortable. Food shops within 50m. I found it easy to find.

description:

description: You can relax with your family in this small, detached house of your own, where you will wake up to the sounds of birds among greenery, like an island in the middle of the sea in the center of the city. It is a 10-minute walk to the beach, the bus stop and the Anadoluhisarı ferry terminal. The historic Anadoluhisarı Castle, Küçüksu Pavilion and Park, and the Sabancı Öğretmen Evi Café are nearby places to visit. You can take a ferry tour of the Bosphorus and go to Sirkeci. You can visit the Grand Bazaar, Topkapı Palace and Galata and return to Anadoluhisarı by ferry.

reviews.text: One of the best Airbnb stays I've had so far. The host was very kind and helpful from the moment we arrived and was always available if we needed anything. You can tell they really care about their guests. The location was beautiful, and the view was absolutely worth the steep road. My favorite part was waking up in the morning, watering the garden, breathing the fresh air, and listening to the birds. It was so peaceful and the perfect escape from the busy city. The only bad thing about this stay was that it had to end. I would happily come back and definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a quiet and relaxing place.

Veysal’s apartment was extremely comfortable and clean, and with an AMAZING roof terrace with Bosphorus view in the evening sun! And an adorable family of cats to welcome you!
Veysal was also extremely kind helping us pay for our taxi when he told us it was cash only at the end of the journey- Veysal was there to meet us kindly when we arrived to welcome us, help with luggage and give us great instructions for the apartment and the local area (which is beautiful and very different to the traditionally tourist areas of the city).
Thanks for a great stay!
Bahçesi ve boğaz manzarasıyla alternatiflerinden ayrışıyor. Merkeze yakın olup aynı zamanda doğanın içerisinde kalabilmiş olması da bir artıydı. Ev sahibi Veysel Bey ile iletişimimiz güzeldi.
Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev tertemizdi, ihtiyaç duyduğumuz her şey mevcuttu. Ev sahibi son derece nazik ve yardımcıydı. 3 gün boyunca çok rahat ettik. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

Harika bir ev ve nazik bir ev sahibi. Ev çok huzurluydu ve rahattı. İstediğiniz her şey mevcut. Veysel Bey bizi giriş saatinden yarım saat önce karşıladı ve anahtarları teslim etti. Huzur, konfor ve mahremiyet arıyorsanız bu muhit tam olarak sizin için. Ek olarak manzarası fotoğrafta göründüğünden çok daha güzel görünüyor ve biraz yokuş çıkmanız gerekiyor. Kediler için de mama getirmeyi unutmayın. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz. Her şey için teşekkürler.

description:
This chic apartment, located on Pürtelaş Street, enjoys a prime spot between the lively areas of Taksim and Cihangir. It’s just a 3-4 minute walk to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street.

Please note, while the apartment is on the ground floor, access involves climbing stairs equivalent to three floors. This may not be ideal for large groups or guests with heavy luggage.

We are offering 1000mbps Fiber Internet for a faster, smoother experience!

reviews.text:
Outstanding Stay in Beyoğlu – Hosted by Aziz
This accommodation was significantly larger than the photographs suggest, making for an exceptionally comfortable stay.
The location is ideal for travelers who value convenience. Restaurants, cafés, grocery stores, and public transportation—including the metro—are all within immediate reach. There is even a convenience store directly outside the front of the building, which made daily needs effortless.
The apartment was perfectly clean upon arrival. Check-in instructions were clear, accurate, and so well organized that there was no need to contact the host at all.
As a travel professional with 48 years of experience, I strongly prefer staying on the contemporary side of Istanbul rather than in the Old City, which tends to empty out in the evenings and where restaurant prices are unnecessarily inflated once tour buses depart. Beyoğlu is vibrant, authentic, and alive at all hours—and this location captures that perfectly.

I had a fantastic stay at this apartment! The location truly couldn’t be better just a 3-minute walk from Taksim Square, yet in a quiet spot that felt peaceful and safe. The apartment was modern, and spotlessly clean. Everything from the fresh sheets to the sparkling bathroom and fully equipped kitchen was well-prepared and thoughtfully arranged.
Despite being slightly below street level, it felt cozy and airy, with no humidity or strange smells whatsoever. I actually found it easy to access, and the stairs were completely manageable even with luggage.
Aziz and the co-hosts were incredibly kind and responsive, they clearly care a lot about the guest experience and were always available if I had a question. Everything worked perfectly during my stay, and I appreciated the attention to detail.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a comfortable, clean, and central stay in Istanbul!

the apartment had a good location, it was okay, a little bit smaller than expected, there was a wierd smell and it felt humid, the apartment is a little below the ground floor and it was tiring to reach it ( alot of stairs) especially with our luggage, the cleanliness was acceptable(the dishes the bathroom the flooring and the sheets felt a little off ), we had some problems ( the gas was empty, and there was no water for a short time) but Aziz and the co hosts were responsive and fixed everything! it was a pleasant experience for a short stay.

We had a good stay at this Airbnb in Taksim, Istanbul. The place is very accessible and close to Taksim Square and the metro, with only a 3-minute walk to reach them. There is also a market just next to the apartment, which is very convenient. The owner is very helpful and responds very quickly. The house is clean, comfortable, and everything was good during our stay.

The apartment is really close to Taksim, which was very convenient.
The house has well equipped kitchen and washing machine and dishwasher. It was clean and spacious—great for a family stay. We felt comfortable throughout our time there. The host was also very responsive. If you’re traveling with elderly people or someone using a wheelchair, keep in mind there are stairs to access the house.

description: Experience the comfort of a new and safe residence! Right below it is a stylish restaurant that can be considered fine dining and one of the country's best coffee chains. There is a large park, a fine dining restaurant and a 3rd generation coffee shop. There is a chain market nearby. There is a swimming pool and a gym available to our guests on the site. For your vehicles, there is plenty of free parking available in front of the site. The facility is protected by 24/7 security.

reviews.text: This was a great stay. Probably one of the best I’ve had. Unit looks exactly like the photos, more spacious than you’d think and was squeaky clean. The icing on the cake for me though was the little things that were included to make the stay just that more complete. Little things that you wouldn’t think of grabbing while travelling, or checking for while shopping for your Airbnb stay, loofas, food seasoning, Q-tips, razors, to name a few. random yes, but it was something I’ve never seen before at an Airbnb. I thought it was pretty thoughtful. lol at first I didn’t think it was for guests, but then I thought to myself, why would it be here then. lol in its original packaging. I’m rambling but just wanted to share how appreciative I was for those little things, coming to a new country, in an area your not familiar with, after a long day of travelling can be overwhelming, so it was nice to check in and see those things. Definitely recommend. Great value, at an unbeatable price point

Den's apartment is in a very quiet and well-kept area. The house was clean, comfortable, with everything provided for guests. The host was very attentive, responded quickly and was always ready to help.

I visit Istanbul often and have stayed in many apartments, but this one is one of my favourites at the top of my list. The apartment is very clean and the owner has kindly and thoughtfully provided everything one might need for the stay. We were so comfortable throughout our stay. There were many great restaurants/cafes and supermarkets around the area which makes it very convenient. Location was also perfect for us. I would definitely stay here again the next time I come to Istanbul. Highly recommend it! 🌟

We had the loveliest experience staying at this apartment — and with such a kind and thoughtful host!
The place is cozy, well-organized, and feels like a real home. The kitchen is well-equipped and very functional — everything we needed was there.
The location is also great: there’s a small park, a shop just around the corner, and a nice surrounding area.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would absolutely recommend it to others.
Big thanks to Denis for adding such warm impressions to our time in Istanbul!
Lovely place. Easy access to everything nearby and great facilities. Would recommend !

description: Located right behind Istanbul's famous Galata Tower this apartment offers amazing views and a comfortable stay. It has a big rooftop terrace with stunning Bosphorus & the old city views. The apartment is 5 mins to tram, metro, bus and ferry stations.This tastefully decorated place has 3 seperate bedrooms and can accomodate up to 8 people. You can access almost all major tourist attractions and sites by walk from the apartment. There are plenty of nice restaurants,bars and cafes around.

reviews.text: The location is excellent, and the apartment is also very clean. Our communication was smooth, and the location is truly outstanding.

We tried to raise our concerns on the first morning after suffering through the first night but never heard back from the hose despite messaging him directly on the what’s app number he had used to check us in. Disappointing as we were stuck with no functioning AC as the unit was leaking everywhere. Great location tho if they do fix the AC and the dank smell.

A perfect apartment right next to the Galata Tower. The view from the terrace is breathtaking. I highly recommend it. A wonderful experience. The most beautiful view in Istanbul. A very comfortable and central apartment.
A fantastic location from which one can visit Topkapi, Blue and Sophia Mosques and Galata tower, fo a Bosphorus tour and get access to restaurants !

description: Located on Sait Halim Paşa Street in Yeniköy, one of the most exclusive districts of Istanbul, this detached house with a garden is ideal for those looking for a comfortable and peaceful accommodation experience. With its modern decoration, spacious living space and private garden, it is a unique environment for both relaxing and having a pleasant time. You can enjoy the exclusive restaurants, cafes and coastal atmosphere around the Bosphorus, which is a 2-3 minute walk away.

reviews.text:
This was one of the most disappointing Airbnb stays we’ve had. The house had a very unpleasant smell throughout, and the upstairs area was extremely hot and uncomfortable. My family was so uncomfortable that they could barely sleep during the stay.
On top of that, there was a loud alarm-like noise early in the morning that kept disturbing us. The listing photos were also very misleading — the property looked much larger, cleaner, and more comfortable in the pictures than it actually was in person.
The sleeping arrangements were not comfortable at all, and overall the house did not meet the expectations created by the listing. Considering the condition of the property and how uncomfortable our stay was, I definitely would not recommend this place, especially for families looking for a clean, quiet, and comfortable stay.

We enjoyed our stay very much in this comfortabele, not so large, lovely house with peaceful garden sitting space and with a beautiful view from the bedroom on the Bosporus. Clean and good kitchen facilities.

description:
This unique and quiet getaway is a 4-storey detached mansion with a garden and pool in a large garden on the north-facing hill of Heybeliada.
On the ground floor there is a spacious living room with a magnificent view, a shared kitchen and a shared balcony. This floor also opens onto a garden with fruit trees. The hosts were incredibly welcoming, friendly, and always happy to help, making me feel at home from the moment I arrived. The property is located on the top of the hill, with the beach just a short walk away. I also really enjoyed the lovely swimming pool, which was perfect for relaxing after a day out.

description: Modern minimalist 2BR apartment on a quiet street in Moda, Kadıköy. Features 2 double bedrooms, a cozy living room, an open-plan kitchen, 1 main bathroom, and a private en-suite. Enjoy a balcony with Kadıköy views. Includes high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, full kitchenware, elevator, and all essentials. Just 15 minutes to metro, ferry, and public transport—ideal for couples, small families, or remote work stays.

reviews.text:
Very good experience, the renting is run professionally - responsive and informative communication, good cleaning, hosts are available whenever you have an issue. Small shop downstairs, just a few meters away - convenient if you arrive late or need something early in the morning (a larger grocery store is located 10 minutes walk away, by the football stadium).
Good option to stay with the family - calm neighborhood, several playgrounds by the water; very nice Göztepe park is not so far away also. You'll get "authentic experience" - plenty of cats, seller of simit bagels walking on the streets in the morning, sounds of adhan.
The apartment is well-equipped, except for microwave oven.
Good to know - walls are not sound-proof - you'll hear neighbors if they speak loud or play music. A window in one of the bedrooms is exposed to a ventilation shaft, not outside; we smelled cigarettes smoke while sleeping.

Very accommodating throughout our stay and especially when it came to our requests. I came to Istanbul for surgery, and Berk and his team were incredibly helpful, responsive, and supportive the entire time. The apartment was very clean and honestly met my cleanliness standards, which rarely happens for me when travelling. I’m usually someone who disinfects everything myself when arriving somewhere new, but I genuinely felt much less stressed about doing that here because the apartment already felt very clean and well cared for. The location was great, and overall we felt very comfortable staying there. I would definitely recommend staying here and would happily book again myself.
We loved our stay at Berk’s place. The host is very responsive. The location is great, very walkable. The AC is amazing, and the place was very clean. We couldn't ask for a better experience!

a very clean and beautiful apartment in a great location, close to everything. Berk was helpful and friendly. Having an elevator in the building was also a huge plus. we had a wonderful experience and would happily stay here again.

Wonderful hosts! They replied very quickly and were so attentive to all our requests. They kindly brought an extra mattress because one of our family members has back problems, which we truly appreciated.
The apartment is spacious, new, and located in a quiet area. Moda is our favorite neighborhood — we’ve stayed there more than once. It’s perfect for living: lots of lovely cafés and bars around, a beautiful seaside promenade, and all public transport stops nearby.
Highly recommended!

description: Modern minimalist 3BR flat in a quiet street in Moda, Kadıköy. Includes 3 double-size bedrooms, a cozy living room, an open-plan kitchen, 1 bathroom, 1 separate toilet, and Kadıköy city views. Fully equipped with high-speed fiber internet, Smart TV, dishwasher, washing machine, iron, vacuum, full kitchenware, elevator, and all essentials. Just 15 mins to metro, ferry, and transit. Perfect for families, groups, or remote workers seeking a stylish and central stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We stayed in this apartment in Kadıköy for 10 days, and the main reason for 5 stars was the outstanding support and fast responsiveness — every request was handled quickly. I’ve heard that in heaven it works the same way 🙂
The apartment was clean, new, and had an elevator, which was very important for us. A small, independently-run supermarket is right downstairs, and a hypermarket is just around the corner, making shopping very convenient.
The location is lively and central, with no exhausting uphill walks. Shops, cafés, bars, and markets are within 5–10 minutes, and the 20-minute walk to the metro and ferry goes through busy streets and is actually very enjoyable. The beach is about 20–30 minutes away.
Weekends can be a bit noisy, which might affect light sleepers. We really enjoyed our stay and liked both the apartment and hosts. For a group of 7, the living room is a bit small, but overall, a great experience.

My stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul was very nice.The host was welcoming and responsive, providing easy check-in and great local tips.
The apartment was spotless, stylish, and exactly as described. It felt both cozy and modern.The location was idea, close to cafes, restaurants, and public transport, making it easy to explore the city.

We, three of us, stayed 4nights and it was far better than expected. When we checked in, hosts (staffs) were waiting and greeted us at the door and helped suitcases. There is a elevator so you do not have to worry about going up and down stairs. Everything is just right there; stores, coffee shops, pubs and restaurants just 3~5 minutes away by walking. And the place is newly renovated and furniture is good. Bathroom is clean and comfy to use. We would definitely recommend this place to out friends and family who travel Istanbul.
Thank you again for letting us stay at your place.

We were very happy to stay at Berk’s apartment 😊
Berk personally welcomed us and helped us check in, which we really appreciated. The apartment is very spacious and cozy, with several lighting options that create a great atmosphere. We would especially like to highlight the cleanliness, everything was absolutely spotless and exceeded our expectations ✨
The apartment has everything needed for a comfortable stay, and all supplies are regularly replenished. There is also a grocery store nearby, which is very convenient😊
Worth ever penny, both in-terms of comfort and location. The hosts do everything they can to enhance your stay. I am definitely booking the same place next time I am in the area.

description:
The studio is located on the second floor.

It features one queen-size bed, a private bathroom with shower, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, storage space for clothes and basic amenities for a comfortable stay.

The windows face the street and provide natural daylight during the day. The layout is practical and thoughtfully arranged, making the space comfortable for short and medium stays.

reviews.text:
As a female travelling solo in Istanbul for a few days, it was a PERFECT studio apartment.
Clean, comfortable, safe, good shower, and everything Ali listed was available and in good working condition. What more could you ask for?!
In an excellent, highly walkable location close to most everything. Just steps away is a mini mart run by Ali and his brother. They open early/close late- super convenient for quick essentials. Ali is a wonderfully welcoming and responsive host who respects your privacy while remaining highly attentive.
Please note before booking. This is a compact space in a historic neighborhood with a flight of stairs and a nearby train line (the noise is minimal and never bothered me). It’s ideal for anyone looking for a cozy, authentic, and charming home base.

This stay offered great value for money. The en-suite room was clean, and all bathroom amenities worked well. The location is ideal—very close to major tourist sight-seen and public transportation. Ali was a fantastic host, easy to reach and very flexible with check-in and check-out times.
The only minor downside is the street noise; you can hear the metro and pedestrians outside. However, I suspect this is standard for most central locations in Istanbul. Overall, a great stay for the price!

Alis place is quaint and peaceful. Matches the photos and description. Ali is a very good host. Always friendly, very responsive, and eager to help. The neighbourhood is very peaceful and beautiful. Good location with quick access to blue mosque and grand bazaar. There is some noise from the tram occasionally, but if you sleep with windows closed it is no problem. Thank you Ali! I will return

We absolutely loved our stay here. Ali met us and directed us to a space to park which after a long drive was so appreciated. He was friendly and helpful and directed us to a great restaurant that was open late.
The location is very convenient. Close to the mosque, the sea and many interesting restaurants and places to see.
The flat was quiet, clean and had a kettle. Bed was comfy with lovely fluffy towels and slippers to use in the bathroom. All very nicely done. I would highly recommend

Ali’s place was exactly as described. The location was excellent, close to all the main attractions. Everything was great, and Ali was very helpful throughout our stay. He also helped arrange a taxi for us from the airport to the Airbnb and back to the airport at the end of our stay. Would definitely recommend!

description: Our standard room with a modern design is 1 minute away from Istiklal Avenue and 5 minutes away from Galata Tower. It offers a comfortable stay with a double bed, kitchen, flat-screen TV, minibar and a spacious bathroom. It provides easy access to the art-filled streets of Cihangir and the coastal walks of Galataport. Suitable for both business and leisure stays.

reviews.text:
Müzisyen olduğum için sık sık farklı şehirlerde konaklıyorum, Blind konserim için burayı tercih ettim. Açıkçası bu kadar sıcak ve içten bir karşılama beklemiyordum. Kendimi bir otelde değil, beni gerçekten önemseyen arkadaşlarımın evinde kalıyormuş gibi hissettim Yüksel ve diğer çalışan arkadaşlar sayesinde.
Tabii ki mekanların arasında “orman sessizliği” aramayın ama o kadar dış sese rağmen yine de sessiz olması da ayrıca şaşırttı.
Konumu harika, odalar son derece temizdi. Hem ev sahibi hem de çalışanlar inanılmaz nazik ve yardımseverdi. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim.

İşletmeniz fazlasıyla yeterli ve rahattı. Bulunduğu konum meyhane ve pubların üst katı fakat biz ne sesten ne de ışıktan rahatsızlık duyduk. Odamız temiz sayılırdı dolapta yenmiş yaş pasta vardı. Resepsiyondaki beyefendi ve hanımefendi bize fazlasıyla yardımcı oldular. Odamızdaki balkonumuz da çok tatlı ve güzeldi. Sadece temizlik bir miktar daha iyi yapılabilirdi, televizyon çalışmıyordu ve oteldeki oda kokusu çok ağırdı. Bunlar dışında kalmamızı engelleyecek hiçbir sorun ya da rahatsızlık yaşamadık. Tekrar teşekkür ederiz.
Konum çok iyi, odalar fotoğraflardaki gibi ve temiz
Good host and a comfortable hotel room in a lively area

Unfortunately, this was not a good experience.
I made a booking through Airbnb, and the host accepted it. However, when I arrived with my elderly mother, the host told us that there was no place available and tried to move us to a completely different area and accommodation. He claimed that the problem was Airbnb’s fault and not his responsibility.
He also kept trying to communicate with me through social media instead of communicating through the Airbnb platform. This made me uncomfortable, as all communication regarding the booking should be through Airbnb.
My elderly mother and I were left waiting for more than three hours while I repeatedly contacted Airbnb Support trying to resolve the situation. I was also told twice that a support representative would call me, but I waited and never received the call.
Overall this was a very disappointing experience. I felt that there was a lack of respect and consideration for guests, especially given that I was travelling with an elderly mothe

description: Staying in this unique and tranquil house, yet being just a step away from everything when you go outside, is incredibly enjoyable; this is the kind of house you'll stay in. 🫵

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at Sam’s Place near Galata! Everything was perfect, the location is amazing, very central and within walking distance of Galata Tower and many great cafés, restaurants, and shops. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out, and we felt very comfortable throughout our stay. I would definitely recommend Sam’s Place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would happily stay here again!
The house is in a wonderful location. The house is exactly as it appears in the photos. It's a clean and functional house. Thank you for hosting me.

We had a really lovely stay here. The apartment was clean, comfortable and very well located, with Galata Tower and lots of cafés, restaurants and shops within easy walking distance. Sam was very kind, responsive and helpful throughout our stay, and communication was always easy. We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you again for hosting us!

Sadly I cannot recommend this apartment based on our experience.
During our stay, the toilet did not flush and we had to repeatedly use a bucket of water. The shower drained into the toilet area, leaving the bathroom constantly wet. The bedroom curtain was broken, meaning we could not properly block the light and had difficulty sleeping. The door was also sometimes difficult to open from the inside.
We also had to buy toilet paper and shampoo because there was not enough provided for three guests. On arrival, the previous guests’ wet towels and bed linen were still in the bedroom and we were asked to put them away ourselves.
Most importantly, after reporting these issues, the host stopped responding, despite our attempts to communicate in both English & Turkish.
The location was good and early checkin was appreciated, but the condition of the apartment and the lack of response from the host significantly affected our stay. I would advise future guests to be aware of these issues before
Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğünden daha temiz ve düzenliydi. Konumu çok merkezi ve ulaşım oldukça kolaydı. Ev sahibi her sorumu hızlıca yanıtladı ve çok yardımcı oldu. Kesinlikle tekrar tercih ederim.

description: You'll never want to leave this charming, one-of-a-kind place with its wonderful 18-square-meter terrace. You will fully enjoy the views of Hagia Sophia, Gülhane Park and Taksim from the terrace.

reviews.text: Mükemmel konum, mükemmel çalışanlar. Özellikle resepsiyondaki yabancı beyefendi çok yardımcı, çok misafirperver, çok güleryüzlü. Tam bir fiyat performans oteli. Teras odasında kaldık, manzarası ve odanın büyüklüğü yeterliydi. Yatak geniş ve rahattı. Tek memnun kalmadığım konu temizlik oldu. Yastık kılıfında ve yatakta kıllar, saçlar vardı. Banyoda da saçlar kalmıştı. Kettle da temiz değildi. Odada bulunan çay ve kahvelerin tadı da bayat ve kötüydü sanırım uzun zamandır beklediği içindi. Teras da çok kirli ve sandalyeler rahatsız, kirliydi. Terasa bakan camlar çamur içerisindeydi. Odanın temizliğine biraz daha dikkat edilirse 10/10 olur. Bir de maalesef giriş saatinden 1.5 saat geç giriş yapabildik, beklemek zorunda kalmak can sıkıcıydı. Buna rağmen odanın yeteri kadar temizlenmemiş olması hayal kırıklığı yarattı.

Such a beautiful place! We really enjoyed our stay. Really good location, in the Old Town, every nice touristic places are in walking distance. The hotel itself is clean, nice, the workers are responsive, respectful and very helpful; the owner is an incredible person. If we will come back to Istanbul, we will definitely stay in the same place 🤍

I really like Fatih's house. The location is excellent and the transportation is convenient. The cats in the hotel are also very cute. If you need anything, just send a message and they will reply very promptly. The only thing that needs improvement is that the wifi signal on the 4th floor is very unstable, so I mostly use mobile data. The hotel owner speaks fluent Chinese and is very friendly😉

Fatih misafirperver nazik ve dost canlısı bir ev sahibi her konuda yardımcı oluyor.
Resepsiyonda çalışan yabancı arkadaşta aynı şekilde herşey gayet yolunda ve güzeldi daire göründüğü gibi temiz düzenli ve gayet güzeldi tekrar kesinlikle tercih edeceğim tavsiye ederim

Ita was really nice to stay in their place . We enjoyed our late night in quite tarrace. Very convenient location and walking distance woth nearby historic llace in istanbul .
Especially, Osama Was very nice guy , always helpful with his smile

description: Enjoy a simple and cozy stay in this quiet, centrally located place. Our building is new.

reviews.text: Very clean and quiet apartment. It was very comfortable and easy to access. Walking distance to the metro station and many shops and malls.
The place is clean and have all the amenities we need like kitchen, fridge, and AC. It is very close to metro so we can travel around easily.
Ev tertemizdi ve hicbir eksigi yoktu. İlker bey son derece ilgiliydi hicbir sorun yasamadik. Ucret olarak da cok uygun. Konum metroya cok yakin.Gonul rahatligiyla tercih edebilirsiniz.
Ev aynı fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi temiz ve düzenliydi. Ev sahibine teşekkür ederim

The place was amazing and truly felt like home. The atmosphere was comfortable, welcoming, and very relaxing. İlker was an excellent host. He was always kind, responsive, and available whenever I needed help or had a question. I really enjoyed my stay and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting.

description: Welcome to your modern and spacious home in the heart of Şişli!

reviews.text: Konaklamamızdan son derece memnun kaldık. Ev temiz, konforlu ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu harikaydı; ihtiyacımız olan her şeye kolayca ulaşabildik. Ev sahibi son derece ilgili, misafirperver ve iletişimi çok hızlıydı. Bir sonraki seyahatimizde kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğiz, herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.
İyi lokasyon, temiz ve yeni daire, profesyonel ve ilgili iletişim
Konumu çok iyi temiz ve nezih bir yer
Good place in great location

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Εξαιρετική εμπειρία! Ο Ömer ήταν πάντα ευγενικός, πρόθυμος να βοηθήσει και απαντούσε πολύ γρήγορα σε κάθε μας ανάγκη.
