Ευχαριστούμε για όλα!

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family. I'm sure you'll be happy to stay in our apartment, which is located right in the heart of Istanbul. We'll always be nearby to meet all your needs. Welcome in advance :)

reviews.text: For this price, it's a good room. The location is perfect if you want to explore the area by foot! There are also nice breakfast cafes nearby. The host is very nice and polite. Unfortunately, the shower was full of mold, and the fridge was dirty as well. Under the bed there is a lot of dust. The rest was clean. We stayed two nights, for this short time it was good, but I wouldn't stay there a whole week.

The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. It’s not very spacious, but it has everything needed for a comfortable stay. It would be even better if there were a microwave and a washing machine available.
The host is very friendly and incredibly helpful. He not only took out our garbage every day, but also responded to any questions or requests within about 10 minutes.
The price is very reasonable for the location. It’s centrally located and only about a 10-minute walk from the nearest tram stop.
The neighborhood feels safe (although it’s not the cheapest area) and has several nice cafés. We especially liked Vegan Istanbul, which is a great option if you’re looking for an affordable place to eat nearby.
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay. Thank you for taking my friend out late at night to find a good kebab place—we really appreciated your kindness.

Many thanks to Host Bekir Cihat and Concierge Abdül Aziz for their assistance. We checked in at 4 a.m., and they kept waiting until we arrived safely.
The accommodation is clean, comfortable and ideally located with easy access everywhere. There is a wonderful café operated by an elderly gentleman downstairs. We always dropped in to unwind after heading back.
We will definitely book here again next time.

- great value
- great location
- good bed, aircon, wifi, bathroom
- friendly host

It was a very nice place to stay. The location was excellent, especially considering the affordable price. The host was also very kind and helpful.
I accidentally left my key in the room, and they came to unlock the door for me right away, which I really appreciated.
The amenities were a little limited, so you’ll need to bring or buy some essentials yourself.
The only downside was that you could hear people talking in the neighbouring room quite clearly, so if you’re sensitive to noise, that’s something to keep in mind.

description: Welcome to your historic Pera retreat in the heart of Istanbul. Located in vibrant Asmalı Mescit, this beautifully restored apartment blends authentic charm with modern comfort. Just steps from Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, top restaurants, cafés, and nightlife, it’s the perfect base for exploring the city. Enjoy high ceilings, abundant natural light, and a stylish, comfortable space designed for an unforgettable Istanbul stay.

reviews.text:
Our stay here was great and I can't recommend it enough! The place is beautiful, very clean and airy. It's fully equipped with everything you could possibly need, and the location makes getting around the city a breeze. The hosts were incredibly helpful and responsive, both before and during our visit. Iris, in particular, was amazing. She made sure we were happy throughout our stay, constantly checking in to see if we needed anything. We truly felt right at home.
Just a heads-up for future guests: it gets loud at night, so expect some noise until around 3 or 4 AM. Also, the apartment is up three flights of stairs, which we got used to, but it's something to keep in mind

This place is great for a group. Very clean and comfortable. Lovely beds and linens. It’s quite noisy, because it’s in the middle of a fun night time area. And there’s a lot of stairs to get up. But the location is great and it’s very light and airy and spacious.

We had such a lovely stay in this beautiful apartment in the heart of Pera. Emre and Iris were wonderful hosts: kind, thoughtful, and incredibly responsive from the moment we booked. They made everything feel effortless, including arranging a complimentary airport pickup for us and being flexible with our check-in time, which we really appreciated after travelling.
The apartment itself was new, spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our stay. Iris checked in with us during our visit to make sure we were comfortable and having a good experience; it was such a thoughtful touch and made us feel genuinely cared for.
The location is perfect if you want to experience the energy of Istanbul. You are right in the heart of the action, with Istiklal Street, cafés, restaurants, bars, and meyhanes all just steps away while still having easy access to public transport and the rest of the city.
A beautiful apartment, generous hosts, and a very memorable stay. Highly recommended.

Thank you so much Iris for your hospitality! Really well located flat that over looks some of the bars and restaurants in that area and a short walk away from the Galata Tower. Very clean and spacious as well, Iris was very responsive as a host so check in and check out was super easy, I would come back here again :)

Öncelikle hem İris hanıma, hem Emre beye bu içten misafirperverlikleri için teşekkür etmek istiyorum. Ev harika bir konumda, yepyeni döşenmiş, yüksek tavanlı nostaljik beyoğlu evi havasında ama aynı zamanda çok modern, tertemiz bir evdi. Konumu o kadar iyi ki, tek adımda metro, tek adımda istiklal caddesi, tek adımda barlar sokağına ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Daha önce çok evde kaldım ama şu an için 1 numaram burası oldu. Her gün bir ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını sordular, bu bile benim için apayrı bir keyifti. Eleştirebileceğim bir nokta bulamıyorum açıkçası. Bundan sonra İstanbuldaki konaklama yerim burası olacak. İşini yapmak için değil de hakkıyla yaptıkları için tekrar teşekkür ederim.

description: Welcome to Ottoman Echo, a beautifully restored Ottoman townhouse in historic Tomtom. Relax in your private heated spa with jacuzzi beneath a vaulted stone ceiling, then unwind by the fireplace or beneath the skylight in the cozy bedroom. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, two bathrooms, dedicated workspace, fast Wi-Fi and thoughtful comforts—all just a 5-minute walk from Tophane Tram and 8 minutes from Istiklal Street

reviews.text:
An absolute standout stay—
This was genuinely one of the best Airbnb experiences I’ve ever had. From the moment we booked, the host went above and beyond to make our stay seamless, even offering to assist with arranging transport pickup
The apartment itself is a masterpiece of comfort and detail. Echo has truly thought of everything you could possibly need, making it feel like a luxurious home away from home. The absolute highlight of the unit was the private jacuzzu-perfect way to unwind after a full day of exploring. The location is a short 5 minute walk straight to Tophane stop making it easy to go straight to all the sites and into the city. We even opted to take a walk across Galata bridge one day just for the view. Super walkable location; not having to worry about parking was a plus. Host was super responsive and always there if we needed anything. They even have a guide to restaurants and things to do around Istanbul.
Truly an unforgettable experience!

Our stay at Ottoman Echo was outstanding from start to finish. The hosts were incredibly welcoming, gave us a short tour of the house on arrival and shared fantastic local recommendations that made exploring Istanbul even better
The property is even more beautiful in person than in the photos. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed, the house was spotless, and it had everything we needed for a comfortable stay
The absolute highlight was the private jacuzzi. We've stayed in many places over the years, and this was honestly the best jacuzzi experience we've ever had. It truly feels like having your own luxury spa. We also booked a massage with Poyraz, highly professional; one of the best massages we've experienced
Great location, close to the main attractions, restaurants and transport, yet peaceful enough to relax. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a unique and memorable stay in Istanbul

Words cannot describe how astonished we were with the cleanliness and caliber of this Airbnb. By far the top Airbnb I’ve stayed at in all my years on the site. I would stay here again and again if I return to Istanbul. It’s a beautiful home in a cute neighborhood and we wish we could have stayed longer to enjoy. The jacuzzi is out of this world gorgeous, as well as, all the other thoughtful design touches around the house. We were grateful for our hosts who showed us a true Istanbul loving welcome. Thank you Jesus and Aida for a memorable stay and your kind hearts.

We cannot recommend this place enough! It is in an excellent location. The little home itself is one of the most beautiful Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in. The jacuzzi is a lovely addition. Our host was very responsive and incredibly kind. The airbnb had everything you need for a very comfortable stay. We very much look forward to coming back.

Very satisfied with our stay! Everything is new, clean, and well maintained. The accommodation is fully equipped and has everything you need. We had a very comfortable and enjoyable stay. Definitely recommended!

description: Stylish and comfortable 2+1 flat in Arnavutköy, Istanbul, close to Istanbul Airport. Ideal for families, couples, groups of friends and business trips. It offers a fully equipped kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, smart TV, washing machine and a spacious living area. Easy access to the market, restaurants and public transportation. A clean, safe and home-like experience awaits you for daily, weekly and long-term stays.

reviews.text: Ev tam fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi temiz, düzenli ve çok konforluydu. Konumu harikaydı, ihtiyacımız olan her şeye kolayca ulaştık. Ev sahibi son derece misafirperver, ilgili ve hızlı iletişim kuran biriydi. Bir sonraki seyahatimizde kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğiz. Her şey için teşekkürler

Slept there overnight and I enjoyed the stay. Lokman was very responsive and would reply quickly and help with anything I needed. However, the stove and air conditioning didn’t work but there was a fan substituted in the living room. I also had trouble locking the door. Overall, despite the downsides, it was pleasant and clean and Lokman provided alternatives for what didn’t work.
Really clean, facilitated late check in and check out. Always ready to answer questions at odd hours!

Bir düğün organizasyonuna katilmak için geldiğim seyahatimde Bio Residence’de konakladım. Daire geniş , ferah ve gayet temizdi . Arkadaşlarımızla çok rahat ettik . Bina yetkilisi çok ilgiliydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz .
Daire temiz ve yeni eşyalıydı. Lokman çok ilgiliydi her konuda yardımcı oldu. Lokasyon havalimanına yakın olduğu için havalimani gidiş ve gelişlerimiz kolay ve hızlıydı. Teşekkür ederim

description:
ELEVATOR (LIFT) – FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION 3 MIN DISTANCE – FREE MINI BREAKFAST – EASY TO FIND – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – NO CLEANING FEE – FREE LUGGAGE STORAGE – FREE BABY EQUIPMENTS – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – ENTIRE APARTMENT (Not shared)
How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with mask and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedsheets and towels 60c hot

reviews.text:
The place is relatively close to Taksim and Port area, it is situated in a quiet neighborhood. If you are traveling on your own car, note, that narrow streets make it challenging to find a parking place.
During the stay we had no hot water for a day, which ruined some of our plans (it was fixed by the host the next day, but I have to note this situation).
Small local breakfast as a compliment was a nice touch (we tried it once).
Overall, we are satisfied with our stay at Güner-Berivan's apartment.

Everything was great, description and photos are real and you get what you paid for. Only downsides were hot water being not hot enough (luke-warm), refrigerator not working properly and overall neighborhood didn't feel safe. Overall it is very worth it, recommend it

I recently stayed at this apartment for five days and had a wonderful experience. The apartment was clean, modern, and well-maintained, making it feel like a home away from home. The living area was spacious, with comfortable furniture and plenty of natural light.
The location was perfect, situated in a quiet neighborhood but still close to public transportation and local attractions. It was easy to explore the city and return to a peaceful and relaxing environment.
The host was extremely accommodating and responsive, providing clear instructions for check-in and check-out, and offering helpful tips about the area. They made sure I had everything I needed and were always available to answer any questions.

Everything was great! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made check-in super easy. I had a very comfortable stay and would definitely come back or recommend it to others. Thank you!

We were delighted with this apartment and the excellent service from the staff, who were always kind and ready to help with any questions. They assisted us with our luggage upon arrival and were attentive and friendly throughout our stay. The apartment was very clean and fully equipped for a comfortable visit.
We liked the area a lot. It is accessible, and although some reviews mentioned it felt "sketchy," we had no issues. We saw police regularly and felt safe. It is a local residential neighborhood that reflects traditional daily life.
The breakfast was a great bonus and they kindly adapted it to a vegan diet on request.
Another reason we chose this place was their support for stray cats and dogs, which we find especially important in a city like Istanbul. We appreciate that, and we wish more places would adopt similar initiatives. In their words: "By booking our apartments, you are also helping stray cats & dogs. We use 5% of our revenue to feed and aid them.
Highly recommended!

description:
Our Villa a historical 170 years old wooden building with an unique style located in the forrest, garden with barbecue facilities, top of the hill far away from noise and stress but still close enough for all the interesting trips, consists of four floors, every floor with separate entrance, Apart 2+3 located on the 2nd and 3rd floor.
The electric bus (İstanbulcard 150TL) drives right past our door, Taxis (350-380TL) are also available. On foot 15-20min., uphill

reviews.text: As a group of 6 friends, we rented both apartments for 3 nights and had a lovely time on Buyukada. On the plus side, Ayten was a lovely and very helpful host and the property is in a quiet location at the very edge of the town. The bedrooms are large and airy and the beds comfortable. Somewhat less welcome was the fact that the property is near the top of a fairly steep hill - on arrival the small electric bus refused to take all 6 of us and our luggage and some of us had to walk as there were also no taxis available at the time. In late May, we found only one swimming place open on the island, around 50 minutes walk from the property and down a steep hill. So on convenience and accessibility grounds gave this AirBnB 4* overall and 3* on location.

Our extended family of eight, including three young children, had a fantastic stay at Ayten's beautiful house. This 150-year-old villa in the forest offers a serene environment and has a large garden and barbecue facilities. It's a peaceful retreat on a hill, yet close to all the sights and restaurants.
We stayed in the top and second-floor apartments, allowing grandparents their privacy while keeping the children and parents together. The house is spacious, spotlessly clean, and well-equipped for a comfortable stay.
The hosts were friendly, responsive, and incredibly helpful, making us feel truly welcome. We highly recommend this place and would be happy to return.
Thank you, Ayten, for your great hospitality!

One of the best Airbnb's we have ever stayed in! We are a family of four from New York, visiting family in Istanbul for 10 days. Ayten & Ercan went above and beyond to make everything perfect... from greeting us at the ferry to helping us get groceries. The house is beautiful... bright, airy and super comfortable. The location is great - incredible views and easy to get around the island. We had breakfast in the garden most days - such delicious foods with freshly baked bread. Thank you Ayten & Ercan! We hope to stay with you again in the future! :)

Harika bir köşk, tarihi dokusu korunmuş, tertemiz ve çok şirin. Balkon manrazarası harika, Ayten Hanım harika bir ev sahibi her konuyla ilgili çok yardımcı oldu, lokal tavsiyelerde bulundu. Konaklamada ihtiyacınız olacak her şey incelikle düşünülmüş her odası birbirinden güzel.

Bu güzel köşkte arkadaşlarımla bir gece geçirme şansına sahip olduk. Ayten Hanım her ihtiyacımıza hemen yardımcı oldu. Evin imkanları, ulaşımı çok rahattı. Konutun konumu ve ortamı çok güzeldi. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz.

description:
Longterm bookings 100 days or more please contact

The pictures speaks for itself, but to sum up I love minimalist design and a sense for details which you can find in my magnificent 1-bedroom apartment. I have lived in Germany, Holland, Norway, and lately Qatar and Istanbul and have traveled around the world. I tried to add details from these specific places into my flat. The location of this apartment is just literally UNIQUE. In middle of the famous streets of Nisantasi, quiet and secure.

reviews.text:
This apartment is exactly as described. Stylishly decorated and homey so you feel like you are in your home away from home. I’m glad we chose this place to rest and explore Istanbul. Clean, comfortable, stocked and perfect.
Things I loved about this place:
*Couch turns into a very comfortable bed.
*cable TV with lots of choices in English. Prime tv/Netflix
*comfortable bed and linens
*quiet location
*its on the first floor
Nagihan was a great host who added some very thoughtful touches. We arrived late at night with our toddler and were so happy to be greeted by Nagihan personally at 2 am. She provided water and chocolates and I was happy to have those two things upon my arrival after traveling for 18 hours.
The apartment was perfect for our family of 3 ( 2 adults and 1 child). We had plenty of room to relax, eat, shower and sleep. Plenty of towels, linens, paper towels, toilet paper and little lotions, shampoos etc.
Nagihan is very responsive.

The apartment is well located approx. 5 min from Osmanbey metro station and 2 min walk from the heart of Nisantasi.
The place is very clean, bed and sofa are confortable and we had access to Netflix on the Tv. Towels and slippers were provided.
Few notes on the apartment: 1/ the WiFi works only in the living room, 2/ AC is also only in the living room but that was fine, 3/ the washer is in the bathroom but you will need to plug it and buy your own soap, 4/ The flat is nice but the building is a little old, 5/ there is a pet shop downstairs and you might smell odors on your way out.
On our second day, they changed the locks of the downstairs door. Nigihan was pretty quick to react as we told her about it. One hour later her very nice neighbor gave us the keys which was really appreciated.
I do recommend the apartment for it’s comfort and location. Communication was good!

I absolutely loved staying here. The location was perfect, very close to the metro which took us everywhere we wanted to go in minutes. The City’s mall is a 5 minute walk and there’s wonderful cafes near as well. On check in we reached a bit late but Nagihan waited to welcome us which was very sweet of her. The place is sparkling clean and very well decorated. She gave us clean sheets to use and the sofa bed was quite spacious and very comfortable.
The place was really cozy and the kitchen had all the essentials already placed. There’s also books for you to read and Netflix, Amazon Prime and YouTube. Personally, I loved coming back here and watching a bit my favourite show before falling asleep. It felt like home.
My overall experience in Istanbul was amazing and I feel this apartment was the main reason for it. It was a comfortable place to go to after a tiring day. If you’re going to stay in Istanbul I hundred percent recommend staying here, I don’t think I could’ve chosen a better place to stay!

The Appartment is well located to osmanbey metro station only 5 minutes, 2 minuets walk to the heart of Nasantisi and lots of little boutique stores around. The place is clean and cosy, comfortable sofa and bed, clean towels, the kitchen had all the essentials already placed, wifi was great. The neighbourhood is quite, safe and friendly people.
Nagihan is a good host, on our arrival she gave instructions to taxi driver on how to get to her place and helped us carrying the luggage to the Appartment and responded to all my messages on time.
Over all this Appartment was a good place to go back to after a day of walk around beautiful Istanbul.
When I visit Istanbul again, I will certainly look to stay here!

When I first stumbled upon this flat on Airbnb, it seemed almost too good to be true. There must be a catch! But everything was as perfect as it seemed online. Nagihan is the most thoughtful, gracious host ever.
She provided us with all the information we needed and showed us around. The flat is just perfect! Kitchen is compact and contains everything one needs. The bed is very comfortable, bathroom clean and compact and the living room is excellent. Location is incredible.
Nagihan had excellent restaurant recommendations and was of great help. She went way beyond to make our long-weekend comfortable and memorable.
Thanks Nagihan and Nisantasi for a wonderful long weekend!
I will be back, Chris

description: The historical building is located in Istanbul’s arts, entertainment, history and cultural district, in other words right in the middle of the city centre, in Taksim / Beyoglu.

reviews.text:
Great location for an apartment in a building converted fully for Airbnb, with responsive and helpful hosts.
Sparkling clean place, and local tips on how to get around were offered during the check in process. Loved the hot water showers (which went out one night but was fixed promptly by our host) and the general cleanliness. Host also seem very approachable, and was extremely responsive via Airbnb messaging.
However, walls were a bit too thin for my personal preference, and it wasn't exactly the most quiet when we were at home (at night and in the morning). Could be either the luck of the draw with the other guests at that point in time or a structural point encompassing all buildings of this particular nature.
That being said, we were out most of the time, so it was okay overall, from a value perspective.

There is no fan/aircond in the room which is a bit hot during our stay where we ended up sleeping in the living room pull out bed. But still value for money stay as its near Istiklal street and super clean and respond is always on time from the host. Wifi connection is a bit slow. Overall its still a good stay. Thanks !

On our visit to Istanbul in August, we booked this apartment. It was in the same price range as other offerings, but at the same time close to the city center.
On our arrival, we noticed the following problems:
1) The apartment looks much bigger than on the photos. It is described for four guests, but in my opinion it fits two adult guests.
2) On the photos, there is a lot of light and the rooms look bright. In reality, the whole apartment is very dark. The light can't enter the apartment through the windows as shown on the photos, because there is a tall building in front which blocks entirely the sunlight.
3) The advertised photos of the apartment are professionally photoshopped / altered, so that the apartment looks bigger / brighter / newer than it actually is.
4) In the description, there are two beds, but there is only one bed and one couch.
5) The view outside the windows is a catastrophe. That is why there are no pictures of the view in the description.
6) The bakery, which is advertised as near the apartment, shares the same bedroom wall. The result is a hot wall which transmits so much heat that it turns the entire apartment into a sauna.
The sauna bedroom was for me a dealbreaker, as I could not rest or sleep at nights, and breathing was also difficult. In short, it was hot as hell.
We discussed this issue with our host, and he solved it very quickly by telling us that he was not in control of the weather or of his neighbors next door. At the end, he offered us to shorten our stay to three nights instead of a full refund.
I felt that this apartment was way overpriced for its shortcomings. I would not recommend this place even if it was a lot cheaper, as in summer it is uninhabitable.

Taner good man and so friendly, apartment not like in the photos In fact it does not look like this, the lighting is bad and there is no view from the windows because there is a building next to this apartment, the apartment is not clean, there is no hot water in the bathroom, the room is psychologically uncomfortable , finally the location is good and there is supermarket near to apartment.

Taner is a great host and very friendly person. He was very flexible with our check-in time, even that we had to change it last minute. Location is very nice, even that it's 5 minutes of walk from Taksim, it was quite cosy neighborhood with all the kind of markets and restaurants around. The flat was looking the same as in pictures, nothing to add more in this regards. The only cons, that I would mention, were the noise from outside that you would always hear inside and lack of a few minor equipments (soap, shower gel, etc.). Overall, it was great experience to spend the time at this place, recommended!

description: Newly renovated historic Ottoman house in Old Istanbul. It has three and half floors in total with three bedrooms, large living room and high designed fully equipped kitchen and dining area. Fully furnished house including washer dryer, TV, Wifi. All the floors has air conditioning. It has been restored by love and attention to details with restored furniture fabrics, carpets meets with Turkish modern finery.

reviews.text: Place is gorgeous, spacious, very clean, kitchen had everything you need. I stayed there with my parents and brother. It was my first time in Istanbul (I’ve been to Turkey before) and I’ll be honest that I would choose different neighborhood like Pera for example. However, I loved this neighborhood. Especially restaurants are much cheaper, food is delicious, service is great. My favorite coffee shop is Pianto. Try their cold brew. People that live there are nice. And it’s cute. We were using cabs at first but then discovered public transport which works great. Definitely discover neighborhood more, it has a lot to offer. Ozkan is a great host. Trust him with your transportation too. My parents were very happy with everything.

Ozkan is a pleasant and polite host who is communicative and friendly as well as accommodating. The house's interior design is beautifully done and is very well equipped inlcuding kitchen appliances, tv, washing machine as well as air-cons. The house however is not meant for those who are unable to take several flights of stairs or for those who are light sleepers as the house makes its own noises (pipes and floors) in addition to a quite noisy neighbourhood with kids playing and adults chatting till late at night. It is also quite inconvenient that blinds must be closed most of the time as you will see people peering through to see what you are up to which makes the apartment feel stuffy (regardless if the windows are open). The apartment lay-out is not convenient for large groups as the lower bedroom does not have a door and the upper bedrooms are literally one joint bedroom. I do generally like the area for walking and because of the friendly community but do find taxi access challenging and the noise inconvenient.

Loved our stay - the apartment was cute and quirky and very spacious for a family of 4.
It’s beautifully decorated, lovely linen etc - feels very home from home and well equipped (although we didn’t use the kitchen to cook at all so can’t vouch for that!)
We were initially a little skeptical about the area and did experience quite a bit of noise on the first night with people shouting outside, but quickly came to realise that although it’s a bit rough around the edges it’s very safe and actually quite charming! Everyone very fThink we’re just not used to it! It was then very quiet the next couple of nights so maybe we were just unlucky.
We loved that you could walk to the most incredible coffee shops in 30 seconds, and a few minutes to the T5 tram which takes you to main sights very quickly and cheaply. In the end we became very fond of Balat - definitely authentic Istanbul and not the more touristy areas.
Ozkan was very responsive and helpful when needed. Thanks for having us!

This house has a great location, close to shops and restaurants. Balat is an up and coming area of Istanbul and this is our second visit. Ozkan is a great host, nothing is too much trouble. The house is really well refurbished, stylish and exceptionally clean. Its just as it looks in the photos.

The place on photos is lovely and the streets are wide. In reality the house is tucked in a very narrow corner. The driver really struggled to drop and pick us up.
I had to point out the cleaning from day one. The lady who communicated with me was quick to respond, but I didn’t trust it is done. The sheets clean, but bathrooms needed to smell clean and fresh, which wasn’t. The house is lovely but needs a lot of care. WiFi super slow especially in the top floors.
TV is not smart and not sure what the purpose of having it. It does not work.
All that was fine, the main problem for me was using the cooker and hot water to shower. Suddenly no hot water and my son had to figure out how to do it. Or we text the lady to come and check.
The gas cooker is a nightmare, especially when preparing breakfast for the children. I have raised the issue with the lady multiple times and she failed to explain how to do it. It was controlled from outside the building and you have to pull a cable out.

description: Our newly renovated 1 bedroom flat is located in a central historical area, a few minutes walking distance from the main Istiklal st. which is known for shopping and entertainment. The flat is on the ground floor and has its own private backyard. Close by there are many small shops and an open food market on Sundays. The area is vibrant and authentic, narrow streets with historical buildings and churches to explore. It is easily accessible to all public transportation.

reviews.text: The unit looked like photos! Location was GREAT!! Quick walk to the metro and even better walk to Taksim and all the great restaurants & shopping. I’ve stayed in Istanbul 3 times this by far was the best.. location wise! No up & down hills just to get to stores and tourist locations! I’d stay there again! Great price for location! Unit is an older unit, keep that in mind but if your looking for a great place and location to tour Istanbul this Airbnb is a great find! Host was very responsive! Checking in after hours difficult due to not knowing location for picking keys up but I arrived extremely late due to flight delays! Ask for extra sheets, pillows, and blankets because there were definitely not enough but over all I give her unit 4 stars!

Excellent value for your money. The host is very helpful and friendly, and the place is spacious, cozy, and clean. It is located 550m from Istiklal street and 1.2km from Taksim square, which is a crazy location considering the price of the apartment. Internet connection in the apartment is sometimes good and sometimes bad, but that problem is easily compensated with a huge TV screen connected to a computer, just like a smart TV but easier to use. All in all, I highly recommend Jelena and this apartment.

Jelena is amazing host, she helped us and answered all our questions before our arrival. All instructions were absolutely clear. The flat itself is good, all things for comfort stay are present, the location is very good. Not far from all shops, restaurants and Istiklal street. But also it is hidden from noisy street, and that is good. The heating works perfect. We arrived when it was quite cold and it was warm inside. Water flow in shower is also good and water is always warm. All looks neat and tidy, bed was prepared for sleep. The kitchen is quite small, but you have all things for cooking. The tv is big and also good, suitable for apple tv connection. Thank you for our stay!

I stayed in Jelena's house with my parents for 8 days and it was a good flat.
- It wasn't easy to find the flat at the beginning cause Google map showed me other roads it will be easier to enter from the road near Euro Plaza Hotel, the location is very good near to transportations, the neighbours are very lovely and smiling :)) we really liked them.
- The flat was clean except the garden.
- Jelena was very reactive and helpful.
I recommend the flat 👌
Its a really good place for its value, it was clean , jelena was thoughtful and helpful when we checked in , the place is 9 min walk to Istiklal street!

description:
FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION – FREE MINI BREAKFAST – EASY TO FIND – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – NO CLEANING FEE – FREE LUGGAGE STORAGE – FREE BABY EQUIPMENTS – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – ENTIRE APARTMENT (Not shared)

How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with mask and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedsheets and towels 60c hot.

reviews.text:
It was a good value given the location and price. The room looks like it does in the photo. It's comfortable, and spacious, and the perfect location and walking distance to the main strip with all the shops. The 24/7 communication was very helpful and timely, and super friendly. The transportation to the airport is also affordable and good service.
I will say the free breakfast they advertise is not worth it, if that's an interest point for you booking. It's barely any food, and the service is subpar.

My stay at this house was amazing because
1- the whole house was really clean
2-bed was comfortable
3-heating system worked well
4-had all the amenities i needed
5-central location which was 3 minute walk to bus
6-staff were AMAZING and really helpful
7- windows don’t let any noise in which made the stay peaceful
8-communication was smooth and super fast
9-free small breakfast
Some minor issues:
1- the light at the door is sensor activated and it would always close and make it hard to see and open the door at night
2- i would need to call the reception daily to switch on the heater
3- like the rest of Istanbul, the house is located on some sort of hill so going to or from it required some climbing energy
Overall, i’d definitely stay there again

The communication with the staff was smooth and efficient, they were prompt i responding and helpful.
The apartment was spacious, had all the equipments needed for a decent stay, fully equipped kitchen and a washing machine.
The overall cost for the stay was excellent, however the apartment looked much older than the pictures, still very clean though.
The breakfast’s quantity was minimal buy the presentation was 5 stars quality. Loved the fact that they had flexible breakfast time till 11am. We would come back again and I would recommend it to my friends .
Thank you Istanberry’s staff for your good hospitality.
Ghaidaa.

Awesome place to stay at. The host is professional and friendly always willing to help. Stayed in 2 of their places, both high quality, clean, as described, breakfast included, close to the main street and overall Beyoglu is the best neighborhood to stay. Would recommend Istanberry to anyone who visits Istanbul.

So, the place is in a very convenient location. Very central, but still quiet. The car and people noise from the streets is very minimal which is a big plus and not at all a given in Istanbul. Very comfortable and high value for money.
HOWEVER, I'll have to say that the vintage approach of the shower with the cursed UK style faucets is always a definitely minus for practicality, although a small one. Additionally, the shower works somewhat randomly. Most of the time it was great, pressure was good and water was warm, but I had one shower where the pressure was negligible and the water temperature kept fluctuating between hot and cold (sometimes being cold for so long that I thought they just ran out of hot water altogether, only to warm up again in second after a while).
They're very attentive to any problems, and reachable at a moment's notice via WhatsApp or other means. If you're willing to overlook some possible minor problems (and perhaps if the shower does not work properly, try again in an hour...) you should have no problems here!

description: Our hotel is located in the old historical places of Istanbul (Kumkapi) and hotel location,walking distance from the Grand Bazaar,Blue Mosque, Saint Sophia and Topkapi Place 15 minute. Our otel is 15 minutes walk from the subway (Marmaray),tram and bus station. The new opened Kumkapı metro station is right behind the hotel

reviews.text:
The place is a perfect example of price quality ratio. It is clean and safe and the hosts and staff are very nice. Do not expect a western hotel experience, but you will be safe and comfortable enough for the money you pay.
The rooms are quite small and a bit dusty, but you will find everything to sleep well and your own shower.
All of the extra help we needed we were provided with. Transfer was arranged via the hotel as well.
Do note, that every day (probably) at 5.30 am a prayer starts near by and we personally woke up from it every time. Nothing too bad to influence our stay, but keep in mind if it will yours.
If you have mobility issues this (and a lot of other places in the area) are not for you because of the narrow stairs and no elevators.
Overall I recommend the place and am grateful to the team of Tavra Hotel.

It's a small hotel, but the facilities are new, walls clean, there are narrow stairs in the hotel to go to the rooms. The location is difficult to access due to being on a very small street. If you come from İstanbul airport at night it is difficult to take a taxi. Perhaps it is better to negotiate a transfer with the hotel. However, it is close to the Beyazıt Metro station and the Grand Bazaar. Get ready to climb streets on hills. The area has many clothing and shoe stores with good prices. Kumkapı's restaurants are very close and with a short walk you will find the sea, there are sidewalks for walking, jogging or cycling. Very beautiful view with boats and ships sailing.

I really enjoyed staying in Tavra Hotel, and Vahap is a good host he helped me a lot to know the locations around the place and was responding to my concerns any time I needed him, the room is so clean and comfortable and look even more better than the pictures. I DEFINITELY RECOMMENDED TO ALL THE PEOPLE WHOS VISITING ISTANBUL.

Thank you for a comfortable stay at the hotel. The communication from the staff was great!
In general, the price corresponds to the quality. You must contact the reception for cleaning yourself (it's free).
The kitchen cabinets are empty (we found a spoon, a knife and a glass in a single copy + some sugar and coffee).
We advise the owner to update the kitchen by adding a couple of plates, some cutlery and a mini stove.
There are also no hooks for towels in the bathroom (you have to hang it on the cabinet door or put it in the sink).

The hosts were incredibly welcoming and kind, and quick in responding to our questions. We didn't need to rely on public transportation to reach the main attractions since they were within walking distance. The room was clean and matched the pictures. Although the neighborhood may not have had an appealing look, it was no safety concern. Great value for the money.

description:
Step into a bright and thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This second floor one bedroom apartment blends modern comfort with a practical layout, creating a calm and inviting stay within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. A skylight fills the space with natural daylight during the day and reveals a charming view of the night sky after sunset, adding a unique and cozy atmosphere.

Everything you need for a perfect stay is right at your fingertips!

reviews.text:
High level of comfort!
We stayed in this apartment for few days in december and it was very nice, above our expectations.
Location
In a walking distance from Galata Tower and everything You might need.
Check in, check out and help
Everything was easy and good, no complaints, thank You!
The building
It is a New building with a gym that You can use. But no elevator.
The apartment
Well-equipped apartment, everything is thought out to the smallest detail. Air conditioner (above the entrance door) is big, powerful but not loud, it was able to warm or cool down the entier apartment in few minutes.
The apartment has a wc room next to the kitchen area and bathroom close to dressing room and bed.
The kitchen has everything that is listed in this ad and full set of dishes.
Bed is comfortable, linens and towels are good qulity. There was another set in the closet.
Wifi is good, TV has Netflix.
The apartment is very warm in winter!
The only thing missing there is a shoehorn :)

The apartment was exactly as described and perfect for our 4-day stay. The location is great with plenty to see and do within walking distance, but also close to public transit for other sights. While there are no kitchen amenities provided, the kitchen is well appointed and there is a supermarket nearby. The air conditioner was fantastic, which was great because it was very warm when we visited. The washer & dryer worked well, and we appreciated the laundry detergent. Communication with the host was fantastic - he checked on us and responded to our questions almost instantly. we highly recommend a stay at this AirBnB.

One of the best Airbnb experiences with a host. About the place: the location is perfect for exploring all the tourist areas and going out while being on a fairly quiet street. We were able to walk to Hagia Sophia and Galata Tower. But the host also provides a metro card for you to top up if you wanted to take transportation (cost .40 - .80 US cents for a ride usually).
Its a beautiful, modern, spacious studio (felt more like a 1 bedroom). There is also TWO bathrooms! Great wifi, great gym, and 24 hour security. But this Airbnb deserves the best review for the host: Mete.
I didn't realize that I needed a HES code while traveling to Turkey and Mete took the time to go through the online process to create the code for me and my boyfriend. He made sure that we had this so that we can enter bars, venues, and public transportation. He also helped us call a trustworthy and great taxi driver to get to the airport at 6am. Whenever I would message him about recommendations, he would message back with SO MANY things to choose from. Mete is the best and I highly recommend this airbnb because of him.

We had the most amazing time at NOA apartment exploring Istanbul. The apartment was spotless (I've never stayed in a cleaner place!) and had everything you could possibly need in the apartment. The views from the windows of the street were lovely (we enjoyed watching the cats across the street go down the emergency fire escape stairs!) and it is so close to so many great places in Galata whilst being in a quiet street. It is a short walk to Galata Tower, a reasonable walk to Taksim square and lots of great historical and eating spots nearby. We also were fine to walk to Galata Bridge and across to the historical centre with Aya Sofia/ Topkapi Palace etc. (about a 45-60 Mon walk). The staff servicing the apartment were friendly and the security who helped us check in were great. Communication with the hosts was always excellent - proactive, friendly, and helpful. We thoroughly recommend this place.

The space is excellent. It is full of so much natural light, because of the two skylights and a wall of windows. Yet, you can block out the light whenever you need with the curtains. It looks exactly like it is presented in the photos.
The location is also within walking distance of many different options; bars, restaurants, cafes, etc. Keep in mind in this area there are a bunch of hills to walk up and down to get to things. Which is easy to navigate.
You can access the tram, so if you want to jump on it to go see sights that's easy to do. Having a washing machine in the space is also handy for cleaning clothes if you need it.
One of the best features of this location is the customer service provided by Metehan, which was excellent. My stay in Istanbul was wonderful because of the amazing suggestions for restaurants, museums, parks, and some local sights he provided. It made my trip so easy to navigate and finds the things I truly enjoyed.
I would definitely rent this space again.

description: While you are resting in this wooden house surrounded by fruit trees, you can light a fireplace, drink your hot tea, read your book and swing in the hammock. If you wish, you can come with your family or friends, light your own barbecue, collect fruits (plum, cherry, apple, blackberry) from the trees and have a pleasant time. It is a very suitable place to spend time with your pets. Finally :) the suspended ceiling bedroom in the gazebo is the favorite of the children. We are gladly waiting :)

reviews.text: Bahar Hn ilgili ve her konuda yardımcı olan bir ev sahibi. Evi tertemizdi. Bahçe çok güzel ve açık havada zaman geçirmek isteyenler için ideal. Ancak wifi olanaklar arasında gösterilmesine rağmen, evde wifi bağlantısı yoktu.

müthiş bir ev sahibi! bahar hanım öncelikle sorduğum her soruya hızlı yanıt verdi ev mükemmel derece temiz ve çok huzur doluydu ihtiyaç olabilecek herşey evde mevcuttu çok tatlı bir köy evi gibi çok güzel vakit geçirdik bahçede çok tatlı bir eşşek ve kedi var kesinlikle kafa dinlemek ve dinlenmek için bu orman içindeki güzel evi tercih etmelisiniz temizlik 10/10 bahar hanım bize esnek giriş cikiş da sağladı herşey için çok teşekkür ederiz tekrar gelmeyi çok isteriz

Bahar Hanım harika bir ev sahibi. Çok yardımcı oldu. Ev, fotoğraflarla aynı, çok hoş dizayn edilmiş. İstanbul’un içinde kendinizi şehirden uzak, doğa içinde konaklıyormuş gibi hissediyorsunuz. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Şehir merkezine çok yakın , ev sahibinin doğal gezen tavuk çok lezetli köy yumurtaları mevcut tavsiye ederim .
Terası çok güzel tüm günümüzü terasta geçirdik . Evin büyüklüğü 2 kişi için ideal 3. kişi için küçük kalır . Yaz aylarında evin içinde durmak zorlayıcı çünkü sıcak oluyor . Bize verilen vantilatör ile anca durabildik , bence şahsi fikrim kış ve serin havalarda oranın keyfi daha güzel çıkabilir .
Peaceful and serene space far from the busy city. Cute friendly animals on the property as well. Bed extremely comfortable and nice outdoor patio. Very pleasant place.

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Istanbul Apart: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Istanbul is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, Duru Istanbul Apart’s mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text:
Before I start the story, I'd like to thank you Mr. Ercan that they met us at 12:00 which is earlier than their official check-in time - 14:00.
There is a great wi-fi connection, pretty clean inside, and you can always contact hosts via WhatsApp.
Unfortunately, the existing pictures do not show the whole picture of the apartment. There are very high steps in both a bathroom and a tiny kitchen.
One of the main disadvantage is that you will hear absolutely everything from the street including minarets (50 meters away), and, in addition, there is a boiler in front of a bed which turn on/off every 10-15 minutes all day long (when it's cold outside I guess). Also, its pressure will go down and the boiler stops working (daily!), hence you must fix it manually with really extreme noise to prevent an idle state. Therefore, you will have to ask host's employee to fix it every day or do it manually with some uncomfortable feelings.
There is a hammam sink with old water.. and incorrect floor level near it, so the water from the hammam sink are in front of the toilet where your legs are relaxing.. :)
So, if you are only adults, the apartment is good for its price, but if you have a little baby, honestly, I don't recommend it. Anyway, if you need a central historical location and you have to save some money, it is a good enough option to go.

We had a very comfortable stay at Yunus and Ercan's place.
It was sparkling clean and had all the facilities and amenities that are required for a comfortable stay.
It's really provides you full value for what you pay.
The hosts helped us and did all their best to make sure we had an easy and facilitated stay.
Special thanks to yunus for helping me carry my excessive luggage all the way to beyezid metro station. So nice and sweet of him.

I can’t make a real review because Ercan upgrade our apartment to another one, so we were staying in a bit different flat (1st floor one). That place was new, clean, nice and cozy. It has all the equipment needed.

Ercan and his partner were always there for us. We had a problem with refrigerator and they kindly helped us by exchanging it to another one.
Also they help us with in and out transfer. Our back flight was in the evening and we were kindly allowed to stay a bit longer than check out time, before going to airport.
The only problems I might call would be bad air conditioning and specific noise level. To create the air circulation you would have to keep the bathroom open with the light on (it’s connected to the conditioner system) or to keep the windows open. But as for as it is the city center, keeping windows open gives you an extra noises from the street. Also, the main door was just next to the very thin wall and our neighbors didn’t care much about using it carefully. So they were slapping it all the time, even in the night, which has awaked us few times. But it’s not Ercans fault, just the building specifics and unresponsive people around.
Otherwise we had a great time staying at this place!

Mükemmel ev sahipliği, tramvaya ve Sultanahmet Ayasofya gibi tarihi yerlere 2-3 dk olan merkezi konum, özenli dizayn ve kusursuz temizlik... Great location , near restaurants and local shops ..

description:
My house is located in Taksim which is the most distinguished part of Istanbul. It is in a quiet quarter. .It contain kithcens and facilities to cook. It is very appropriate for a family.

reviews.text:

I want to highlight that Ali, the host, was exceptional. I give Ali a perfect rating of 5/5 points.
The cleanliness of the flat was good.
The location of the flat is also a major advantage.
The internet connection and other facilities provided were of good quality.

room was clean and location was super perfect

House is near Taksim square which you can go wherever with bus and metro
Alley which house was in it was not that much clean but remember this is downtown and all alleys is like that.

We spent the whole night in IST apt because he have changed what he said. 22nd July before confirming the hotel, i asked the host if we can check in 3rd Aug 0000hrs. because the check-in time says 1400hrs. Good location, only a few minutes away from Taksim. Nice restaurants nearby. It was fine for a 5 night stay for three people - however the beds are a little uncomfortable and the kitchen utensils are quite sparse. The host is very friendly, helpful and responsive.

Ali is, without a doubt, a super host. I stayed here for 5 nights. Ali was always attentive to how comfortable my family and I are during the stay. description:
A lovely Ottoman-era wooden house , located in the very heart of the historical peninsula of Istanbul.
Our flat is on the ground floor of a traditional Ottoman house which was restorated in 2013. The place is located in the center of the historical peninsula of Istanbul. It's a few minutes walk to the metro and tramcar stations, Süleymaniye mosque and Beyazit Tower in the main campus of Istanbul University. Within a ten minute walk you will find yourself in Sultanahmet region and Grand Bazaar.

reviews.text:
Pros:
1-landlord and owner are so supportive, they helped us in many things, to manage to arrange a ride from/ to the airport with very good price. They were very responsive, they reply so quickly to any issue we had and tried to solve it as soon as they can. They helped us to do the PCR test at home and get the results quickly.
Also they were very helpful to let us check in early as our flight arrives early in the morning.
2- the flat is exactly as shown in pictures.

Recommendations:

I have lived in the apartment for a week. The location is absolutely fantastic, it is in the very heart of Istanbul, 3 minutes walk to Suleymaniye Ьosque, with a very friendly neighborhood.

Very comfortable apartment in a great location. Everything is in a walking distance. Not exactly like pictures, but actually slightly better. hello my fellow travelers if you want to be in the middle of what Istanbul can offer this is your place , you literally don't have to ride a car everything within 10 to 15 minutes walking except going to Taksim and beyond, very safe neighborhood many I mean many options of restaurants even there is a Playstation shop where you can go and compete with local players I felt at home the place is safe I come back at 3:00 4:00 a.m I was never bothered at all, takes about 3 minutes walking to reach the main Street to get a taxi , Erhan was great he checked on me everyday he helped me with everything I needed, they cover everything you need from towels hair dryer umbrellas full kitchen if you want to cook your own food hot water all day long heater in every corner, I couldn't ask for more to be honest with you great value highly recommended.

reviews.text: Everything was basically as described. The apartment had a very strong smell of smoke, as smoking seems to be allowed inside. Tremendous value for the price. Beyazit’s place was clean, comfortable, centrally located while still being in a quiet area. Beyazit was excellent at communicating and answered my questions before I even asked them! Location wise, the apartment is in a prime spot, centrally located near the hustle of Kadikoy but also walkable to the buses and ferries. I will be staying here again next time I’m in Kadikoy and highly recommend this place to anyone looking

We stayed there for 2 days, and overall we’re happy about our stay. Location is good, easy to find, same apt as in the pictures etc. There was only 2 things that we weren’t happy about. First one is room lightings. Lights are not so bright that you can’t read a book or do something that u need a light. Smooth lights can be moody n cozy…i get that, but its cool when u can choose the lighting level. Unfortunately you can’t choose ur room light to be bright in there. Second problem is there was a emergency door that connects directly to the outside (u can see the door in the pictures). In any summer days it shouldn’t be any problem or maybe can be even advantage, but we stayed there in maybe the coldest days of istanbul and we were losing all of our room warmth through that door. So the room was so cold that i even got sick from cold. Otherwise there was no problem and the apartment is totally worth for the price.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this incredible Airbnb, and I can't stop raving about it! From the moment I walked in, I knew I was in for a treat. The apartment is absolutely stunning – spacious, beautifully decorated, and immaculately clean. The location couldn’t have been better! Nestled in the heart of the Kadikoy.
Staying here was an absolute dream – it was like having my own little slice of heaven in the city. If you're looking for a place that combines style, comfort, and convenience, this is it! I can't recommend it highly enough and would definitely stay here again in a heartbeat.

The sofa is useless. It can't be used neither as a bed nor as a chair.

Great location. The apartment is clean, comfortable, quiet enough, I rested. The apartment has everything you need. Well met, if necessary, they provide assistance. I will be glad to return

description:
It is a sunny apartment in a great location. Few steps to Blue Mosque and Sultanahmet Hippodrome square. Few minutes walking distance to most points of interest. Has two bedrooms, one living room, kitchen and bathroom.

It is on the 3rd floor. No elevator. Not recommended for guests with health and/or mobility issues. Not recommended for travellers with a lot of heavy luggage or a lot of equipment such as strollers, etc.

All rooms including the living room have air conditioner.

reviews.text: The apartment's location was great, it is less than 5 minutes away from the blue mosque. The apartment was clean and it looked exactly as the pictures, just the couch had some stains which they can easily fix by washing the covers. The sea view from the living room was great. The apartment was well equipped, but they didn't have an oven, just a microwave instead. The TV cable had a lot of channels but mostly all in Turkish . The downside of the apartment was the stairs. We didn't mind that the flat was in the 3rd floor and that the staircase was steep and narrow, we just were not very comfortable with the handrail being unstable as it was partially broken from the base in the ground floor. But overall we liked the apartment and we would recommend it. The wireless internet was fine but sometimes it was very slow. Just one time the water was cut off for half a day. We didn't meet Nahide in person but her friend Yasin gave us the keys to the apartment and he was very helpful and nice. Nahide was helpful and kind as well, she allowed us to check out late and arrange both the transportation to and from the airport at a cost of 60 Euros total.

This was a perfect stay in Old town! The location was a short 5-10 minute walk to the heart of old town near the hippodrome, Blue Mosque, and Hagia Sophia. Many restaurants, markets, and shops nearby.
The apartment was well equipped with AC that worked well in both bedrooms and the main living space, a supplied water jug (and refills) for drinking water, cooking supplies, a dishwasher, a washing machine, and clothing drying rack. The beds were comfortable and the place was well cleaned. The stairs (especially with a stroller) required effort but it was worth it for a beautiful mosque and sea view.
We stayed with our 1 year old and Nahide kindly had a portable crib and a high chair set up upon arrival.
Nahide provided clear details for the stay and was very responsive. She arranged transportation from the airport to the apartment which was very convenient for our late arrival. She also supported us to arrange transportation to a car rental location in New Town upon check out.

We had a wonderful stay in Nahide's apartment in October. For the location and view alone I am calling this a 5-star (though for the overall experience, my husband and I would say it was less). We were just steps from a market and restaurants, and down just one more very short block we were at the Blue Mosque and its surroundings. I enjoyed several peaceful mornings watching the sun rise over the local mosque and the sea, taking many photos as the light changed and trying to catch the local seagulls in the photo.

There were a few drawbacks, most of which the host can't help--the stairs and surroundings areas in the complex were somewhat dirty and there was a lot of construction going on next door. It was also very hard for us to operate the heavy, seemingly antiquated lock-key systems on the upper and lower outer gates. There were a couple times I didn't want to leave the apartment for a quick trip b/c I just didn't want to hassle with working the key over and over trying to get in and out.

However, for what you have to work with in the Sultanahmet region I think the apartment was well worth it for the great location and views. Nahide was also VERY kind. We were late in getting in, having a delayed flight and then having some problems mailing an urgent letter at the airport, and Nahide was waiting for us with her young daughter, who was getting tired and 'antsy'. However, Nahide was still very gracious and still offered to take us around the neighborhood (which we declined, so she could leave). The added travel books and metro transit card in the apartment were also a very nice touch.

As other reviewers have noted, the apartment stairs are also rather steep and narrow. We didn't mind at all, but be aware of that if you find narrow, circular stairs to be an issue.

Overall, other than the problems that we had with the keys (which no other reviewers mentioned, so maybe the problem was just for us), I wouldn't hesitate to return.

I had a wonderful stay at Nahide’s. The photos of the view from the apartment don’t do it justice. It is absolutely beautiful. I’m not sure any photo could do it justice. The apartment is clean and quiet and ideally located. Everything is as lovely as in the pictures. Comfy bed. Excellent shower. Nahide and her husband were very accessible before and during my stay, flexible and so helpful when I left. Thank you so very much. I highly recommend your apartment to anyone and everyone.

The apartment has a gorgeous view and looks exactly how it is shown in the photos. It was very spacious / clean and within easy walking distance of public transit and major tourist destinations. I recommend using the SHOW Supermarket for groceries as this was the closest to a full grocery store we found in the area. I also appreciated Nahide arranging the transportation to and from the airport as the airport is a bit chaotic if you try to book a taxi as you are landing, so this made the process much smoother. She was very responsive and always responded within minutes to seconds. We also really appreciated the water cooler as the tap water is not drinkable in Turkey. The apartment has all little things you need.
Con is that there is no real fire escape. This is probably true of many old buildings in Turkey and no fault of Nahide, but was something we noticed from the beginning. There was a small fire in the basement's building during our stay making it more relevant.

reviews.text: Arda was a fantastic host and I really enjoyed staying at his place. The apartment itself is beautiful and cosy, with lots of plants, and the bedroom was very comfortable, with a really nice bed. The apartment itself is remarkably well-maintained; it is clear that Arda and his partner have put a lot of energy and care into making their house a home. The internet, hot water, washing machine -- everything works splendidly. The house is also in the perfect location, close to everything Kadıköy has to offer and yet on a quiet street with a friendly neighborhood feel. I definitely recommend Arda's place for anyonw looking for a fun, relaxing time in İstanbul surrounded by warmth, comfort, and great people.

Just fantastic.

I work remotely so internet quality is very important for me. Arda's internet connection was perfect throughout.
Apart from the room, Arda and his partner are just great people. Openminded, conscious and warm. I'll be back without a doubt!!

Great location. Great hosts. Arda and his boyfriend are very kind and well-educated people. The apartment is very well-maintained, cozy and clean. It has a good vibe too! The place is sure worth its price.

description: Welcome to VNG Property's brand new modern loft duplex in the heart of prime Nisantasi! With 2 bedrooms/2 bathrooms, a walk in closet and high ceilings! Close to all the tastiest restaurants and cafes and all the fanciest trendiest shops! Situated on the fourth floor w/ elevator and is walking distance to all transportation links. The perfect home away from home! We invite you to come stay with us! Comes w/ Wifi, Netflix, all new white appliances and a fully fitted kitchen!

reviews.text:
First , amazing organizing and speaking English perfectly
The house is perfect as described
It’s on the last floor with fast elevator
Duplex , loft , two bedroom
Two separate bathroom with showers and heaters and all required
Amazing view to the city
Massive windows
Perfect safe stairs to upstairs
Fast WiFi that works in every area of the house
Smart tv
Fully equipped kitchen
Complementary 1.5L bottle of water
Clean towels and sandals to use packed
House is fully sanitized even toilets on arrival
House price is worth it compared to all other property in the area
Amazing location
Safe neighborhood
Amazing landlord that allowed to us to extend our stay for one hour until 12
Fast response
Spacious room in cabinets with enough hangers
Brand new washing machine with dryer
Hair dryer in the toilets
Shampoo and solid soap
For our dear Arabs and Muslims the toilets has water to wash your self not only tissues
Specious room in the loft
It’s a loft and a penthouse as it’s the last floor and quick elevator
Only no safe box
I totally recommend this property don’t miss it out

For those looking for home away from home this is not your place. No parking unless you pay or go around 10,000 times to find a free one, horrible traffic, uncomfortable beds, no cleaning supplies (broom, mop, cleaning liquids for the apartment) not even trash bags or extra toilet paper for a family staying 8 days it just doesn’t make any sense. Only 1 towel were given per person for 8 days until I had to reach and request for someone to provide more and they ask us to give the ones we use back. (Like if we were going to take them with us) and of course they only bring 1 towel which had stains as they were white. No extra linen either. The floors were stain and not clean you could feel the dust as you walk without shoes. Hair dryer were broken and they said we were going to get new ones which never arrive. The communication was terrible, this place is like a 1 star hotel type of quality. This is our 3rd Airbnb in Turkey 🇹🇷 and All of my experiences on Airbnb have been beautiful here and other places, this one felt like a punishment not a vacation, couldn’t rest without pain in my back for the uncomfortable mattresses for my in laws and us. The kitchen area was the only place I really enjoyed because I had enough space to place groceries and cook delicious meals. We really don’t recommend this place because is not a person is a type of a company trying to treat this as a hotel (a bad quality hotel) when it is supposed to be home away from home.

This is our third trip to Istanbul in the last 3 years, and we wanted to stay in Nişantaşı area for our 5 night stay because of all the shopping and restaurants. This Airbnb is on the quieter side of the district, and literally a few minutes from all the action. Exactly what we were hoping for! It truly felt like a home. Plenty of space, full kitchen, very clean bathrooms. We appreciated the safe code access to the building itself and elevator to top floor. There is a little market right across where we stopped in daily for drinks, snacks, etc…and so many coffee shops and borek/simit bakeries within a min walk that I was able to get for family every morning. Cabs were easily summoned from the BiTaksi app. We would stay in this unit again in a heartbeat. Truly a home away from home. The service and responsiveness of the VNG Property Management was top notch. I couldn’t recommend enough, we look forward to making this our home next time we come. 😊

Everything looked as described and shown in the pictures, beautiful and clean. The location was amazing, walk distance to any coffee shop, restaurant and shopping in that neighbourhood, it was a safe and friendly neighbourhood. The VNG Property was very responsive to any question or need that we asked. Overall would love to go back to this place again.
Azin

Everything was perfect !
VNG is very responsive and helpful,
The loft is exactly as it shows in the photos
Location is just perfect in Nisantasi and walking distance to lots of shops and cafes nearby,
Would definitely recommend it !

description: Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place. As you can see in the images, it's a neighborhood with a hotel atmosphere, it just has a few shortcomings.

reviews.text: Tüm sorulara içtenlik ve açıklıkla cevap verildi. Giriş ve çıkışlarda esnek ve çözüm odaklıydı. Ev aynen fotoğraflardaki gibi, bulunduğu site mükemmel bir konumda ve kaliteli bir site. Kendi evimiz gibi rahat ettik. Bu bölgelere tekrar yolumuz düşerse muhakkak tercih edeceğimiz bir yer olacak. Fiyat/performans olarak şimdiye kadar kaldığım evler arasındaki en iyisiydi diyebilirim. Tekrar teşekkürler.
Yatak rahatsizdi ve pek temiz durmuyordu. Banyodaki cop agzina kadar doluydu. Bunlar disinda fena sayilmaz. Cevrede daha ucuzu yokken degerlendirilebilir.

Daha önce misafir olduğum bir ev sahibi kendisi her misafirliğimde tekrar tekrar memnun olabileceğiniz bir yer. Kendisine tekrar tekrar teşekkür ederim. Belirttiği gibi tertemizdi heryer giriş konusunda her zaman ki gibi süperdi.
Ev sahibi gayet ilgiliydi. Ev temiz ve düzenliydi.
Mehmet Bey son derece kibar bir ev sahibi. Evi oldukça ferah ve temiz. Birden fazla kez kaldım ve çok memnunum.

description: A beautifully decorated, comfortable space, where you can call home right in the centre of Istanbul. The flat is located a short walk from Taksim Square. Enjoy this stylish and artistically decorated home & it's convenient location. There are 4 bedrooms in the apartment and each room has its own Air Condition so you can set up your own room temperature.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our time at Deniz’s beautiful and spacious apartment . We had a party of of 8 and comfortably fit in the spacious 4 bedroom apt. There is additional room if you have a larger party . The apartment was very clean and artistically decorated . The location was very good and convenient . Close enough to The famous Taksim square with a short taxi /Uber ride . There is a one and half bathroom , however we didn’t have any problems using and sharing the shower as we had different schedules getting ready in the morning . We had a family reunion and not having seen each other for a decade or so, some of us did not know each other well . Sharing an apartment brought us much closer and we had fun playing cards and having conversations. we enjoyed the convenience and familiarness of home prepared breakfast and dinner When were too tired to hit the streets . We had a fully equipped kitchen . The neighborhood is filled with fast food restaurants, Bakeries, cafes , ATM, and markets . Very convenient to just walk downstairs to get all the necessaries from the small market around the corner . Deniz was very helpful by providing us airport transportation and being very patient and in constant communication with us and the shuttle driver until all in our group arrived at the airport ( it took 2 hours between our flights due to delays) . Deniz also graciously provided some great tips about shopping areas and taxi and Uber directions written in Turkish since the taxi and Uber drivers didn’t speak any English . Overall we had lots of fun in Istanbul and loved our apartment . Thank you Deniz ! Love Beautiful Istanbul !
Tiffany

Deniz is an amazing host and her apartment is pretty good for large group of people. We were party of 8 stayed at her apartment for two weeks. She arranged transportation from airport for us and welcomed us with complementary refreshments. She shared tips about things-to-do in Istanbul which was quite helpful. The house was clean, kitchen had the necessary silverware, and kitchenware. Fridge was working really well. Shower was clean and I love the pressure of water in shower. The house has 4 bedrooms. All of them were great but the bedroom that has window to the street is noisy and imo needs acoustic glasses to absorb the outside noise. Plenty of grocery, butcher, and fish stores around the house. There's a bus stop in less than 1 minute walk from the apartment and it's quite convenient to get to different places in istanbul. Apartment is on a hill and walking up the hill could be challenging. I tried it 3-4 times and it's a good work out to burn the delicious foods I had in Turkey. Deniz arranged complementary cleaning for the second week of our stay which was nice.
The only downside of apartment was the renovation upstairs. Make sure to check with Deniz about it. Specially if you want to stay in the apartment from 9:00-5:00 resting. It's gonna be noisy.

First of all I want to thank the great host Deniz, she was so kind, flexible, and easy going. Deniz provided us everything we need at the apartment. My family and I felt so comfortable because the apartment is so clean, cozy and big enough for a big family. Also, the pictures posted for this apartment are exactly the same. The apartment is well designed. The location is near Taqsim square also supermarkets, bakery, restaurants, and pharmacy. Basically everything you need you will find within a walking distance. Finally Deniz and her apartment deserves a five stars I highly recommend it.

The neighborhood is very lively, if you want to live in a touristic area, you are at the wrong place. The food is everywhere around the flat, and there is a tea house just down stairs where you can find the best red tea in Istanbul, and for a derisory price.

The flat is nearby Taksim square, the city centre, and you can get there for 10 lira in 5-10 minutes, 20 minutes to Eminonü ( historical part) and almost 70 lira to S. Gocken airport. Just remember that taxi drivers are everywhere.

The flat is decorated with taste, there is everything you need in it, and it looks exactly like the pictures, no surprises.

Dündar is very welcoming host, you can ask him for good spots in the city, depending on what you like to see. He is not intrusive, but if you need him, he will answer.

In fact, if you like the pictures, and want to be welcomed by a nice host with a good English, and live like a real Stambouliote, just rent it.

I saw Deniz' lovely photo of her airbnb and booked it for 3 nights for 6 travelers having just spent 14 days in Madagascar. Deniz arranged transport from Istanbul airport to her place, a wonderful help as this was our first visit. The place is located on the first floor of an old, grand apartment building next to Kurutas Street, in a busy neighborhood with lots of shops, restaurants, modern grocery story and a bus stop.
Deniz met us as we arrived and was very gracious, explaining the basics of her place and how to get around. Her place is clean and well equipped with plenty of hot water for showers any time of day. There is a brand new fridge, a full stove, washer/dryer and A/C in the rooms. Although there is a great information booklet put together by Deniz, you might get further info on the operation of the washer/dryer and A/Cs in the back two rooms.
The place is large with plenty of space for the big table and two sofas in the common area.
The kitchen is convenient with stove, dishes, toaster, coffee pot and so on.
We were very happy to have found Deniz and this great space, and would recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. Additionally, Deniz is a great communicator and is willing and ready to assist - a real bonus for those new to Istanbul.

description:
Jun-Do Taksim is located in the heart of Istanbul. Just few steps away to Taksim Square and Istiklal Avenue.
The building has 7 airbnb apartments with large elevator. Each apartment has new furniture with well equipped. We try to think everything for our guest comfort.
High class, comfy,, luxury,,,whatever you need by eRa Quality.

reviews.text:
Nice photos, harsh reality.
The apartment is fine overall. Great location, 3 minutes to Istiklal, lots of restaurants, transit right outside, easy to get anywhere. Public transport in Istanbul is great, you can just tap a credit card.
But the place is clearly made for renting, not for living. An old sagging mattress, heavy dust under the bed, a burned sofa, shower flooding and mold. Almost nothing in the apartment except cups and forks. There is a washing machine but no detergent, no extra blankets, no spare linens.
It is noisy, which is normal for Istanbul. Still, small things like earplugs, which are standard in many Airbnbs and hotels elsewhere, would show some care.
The host was responsive and check in and check out were easy.
Good if location is your priority. If you value comfort, look elsewhere.

We had a very good stay in this apartment in Istanbul. The location is extremely central, very close to Taksim Square, which is a big plus for exploring the city. Everything was as described, and the apartment was very clean.
Communication with the host was excellent. He was extremely friendly, helpful, accommodating, and proactive, which we really appreciated.
Because the apartment is in such a central area, you can hear some traffic noise, but for us this was not a problem. The apartment felt maybe a little smaller than it appears in the photos, but everything we needed was there and everything worked well.
Overall, we had a great time and would definitely recommend this apartment.

Great location and a beautiful apartment. The staff were extremely friendly, proactive, and always helpful. A small issue came up during the stay, and it was fixed immediately with professionalism and a smile.
The apartment was very clean, well maintained, and had all the essentials needed for a comfortable stay. It is also in a very convenient location, only a two minute walk from Istiklal Avenue and around six to seven minutes on foot from Taksim Metro Station. The area is very walkable, with many shops, cafes, and restaurants nearby.
I would recommend it for two to three people, especially for a short stay in Istanbul. The only small suggestion would be to add more storage space for belongings. Other than that, everything was excellent, and I truly enjoyed the stay.

We had a great stay and were overall very satisfied with the apartment. The location is unbeatable—right in the heart of Taksim, which made it super easy to explore the city. The apartment itself was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as shown in the photos.
Yes, it can get a bit loud at night, but we were aware of that beforehand and it didn’t bother us—in fact, it added to the charm of staying in such a lively and vibrant area.
