The only downside was that the building where the apartment is located has a strong smell of fast food and could be a bit cleaner in the common areas. But once inside the apartment, everything was very nice and comfortable.
We’d definitely consider staying here again!

Highly recommend! Excellent location, Apartment is really nice, comfortable and with elevator. Easy to access Taksim Square and Istiklal Street area, walking distance around 3min, the host are responsive, friendly and helpful. Rooftop lounge nice shisha smoking and amazing view.

description: I would be pleased to host you in my apartment, which is within walking distance of Uskudar centre, Marmaray, Baglarbasi metro, Nevcarsi and Capitol shopping mall. My apartment is located in the nuh kuyusu street where the bus stop is in front of my building that you can find the buses to everywhere in istanbul. Kadikoy is just taking 5 min from her by bus. There is even dry machine in the apartment for free usage. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to ask.

reviews.text: Thanks for hosting me Murat! The house was quite clean and was as it is at the pictures. It is so close to metro station and bus station. even takes 20 minutes kadikoy by walking. We spent a lot of time with him. He is such a funny boy. Highly reccomend my friend!

This property is clean an spacious. The room was plenty big. The bed was VERY comfortable. The host does not permit alcohol (a good thing). Murat is super respectful and always in a great mood. He has a calm demeanor, which is very welcoming to the weary traveler. The local community is friendly. The mall is close by foot. I highly recommend this choice as a strong consideration. Also the roommates were friendly and nice. It was fun to hang out with other travelers as well who live there.

Murat was a nice Person who tried to help me, but to be honest the Appartement isn‘t worth the money. The Appartement wasn‘t that clean and also the Bathroom wasn‘t the same like the Pictures.
So at all i don‘t want to be rude to Murat he was a nice guy, but i wouldn’t book the same Appartement again.

I really loved Murat's place. It cozy, private and feels like a home. It's very near from bus station. for someone who like to walk it is also walkable to Marmaray station. You can easy find supermarket, restaurant, bakery, ATMs and even cheaper market on every Thursday near. Highly recommended.
Murat is also friendly and someone who checks up on you everytime

Murats place is indeed on a great location. 15 minutes' walking to the sea and also plenty of restaurants, markets, anything you can possibly need you can find withing a few minutes walking.
Hes is indeed a sociable person, who cares about his guest. Constantly offering information about anything and encouraging me to visit this and that place. Definitely worth to stay at Murats place.
Thank you bro for your hospitality! i appreciated it. :)

description: This is a cozy private room with the bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 4-5 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City. Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.

reviews.text: Kimil and his team were very helpful and welcoming when i arrived. Everything as described on his profile and subsequent clear messages were true to their content. The cave room is lovely, the terrace has create views of the Blue Mosque and also the port. Breakfasts are traditional and nothing missing. The room is located very close to the old historic mosques and not to missed roman water system. For the price, location and fabulous hospitality and assistance during my stay, i would five it 5/5 - i will certainly return.

The pictures on the listing accurately represent the space, the unit was clean and in a great location.
However, our experience staying at the unit started poorly as the host double booked the unit although we gave prior notice that our flight into Istanbul would arrive at 5 AM and we booked the night before to ensure we had the room upon our arrival.
Once we arrived, we were informed the room was booked by a hotel guest although we had already purchased the night for this room. We were offered another room of much lesser quality in the interim and no acknowledgment of the double booking or offer for reimbursement.
In addition, there was no working A/C during our stay. We had informed the host of all these issues. The host did not respond to the issue with the double booking and did not resolve the issue with the no A/C, outright ignoring our messages.
All of this could very well be a one off experience and your experience may be better, the place is accurately described.

Like the location a lot, just on the edge of a busy neighbourhoud, very close to major attractions. Very clean. Quiet (no traffic noise, as rail is still work in progress). Spacious.
Very friendly personell.
Beds are too hard for my concern, and pillow too soft. But thats personal.
Only on saturday I heard the mosque close by at 6AM, but don't think you can avoid that in istanbul.
Some shops very close by, and if you like can eat breakfast within 3 mins walk in restaurant.
There were enough numbers to call when I arrived for entrance. But can take 10 mins or so. Not annoying, I could even use Wifi for search as they mentioned acces code on note (had issue with mobile connection on my phone). Showing that owner is very helpfull (as all people were indeed!).
All in all : I was very happy that I booked here.

Good location, but be aware that all the cafes and restaurants in this area are quite expensive. Also, the breakfast at Deniz Houses Hotel, which is part of Naz Wooden Hotel was disappointing and expensive.
The room was vey clean though and comfortable. The staff is super friendly and nice and I felt very welcome.

The accommodation we were given was not what we originally booked on Airbnb. Two days before our stay, the host informed us that there was an issue with their reservation system and that the property was “overbooked.” As a result, we were relocated to a different place (Deniz House Hotel).
Unfortunately, the alternative accommodation was significantly smaller and did not match the listing we had originally chosen. This last-minute change caused unnecessary stress and disrupted what was meant to be a relaxing weekend trip.
Additionally, the condition of the room was below expectations—fixtures such as the toilet roll holder were loose, the bedsheets had visible stains, and the overall space felt cramped and poorly maintained.
We also did not receive a refund and had to contact Airbnb Support to address the issue.
Based on this experience, I would not recommend this host, particularly due to the last-minute change and the discrepancy between what was advertised and what was provided.

description: Central, well-designed duplex apartment with Historic Greek church view

reviews.text: The apartment was located in a great location, close to grocery stores, lots of restaurants/coffee shops, and less than a 10 minute walk from the train station. It was located a short train ride from Sultanahmet and the Eminonu area, making it easy to go to other parts of Istanbul. The bedrooms were spacious and sunlit, and the beds were comfortable. The view from the top floor balcony was great. The kitchen was well-stocked with utensils and common use spices. The bedrooms are located on the middle floor and the living area is on the top floor. Going up and down the stairs wouldn't be comfortable for anyone elderly or with mobility issues. Other than that, I would highly recommend Beglu's place to anyone looking to visit Istanbul. She was helpful in answering our questions and very responsive. I'm so glad we chose this place to stay in! It definitely made our stay in Istanbul very enjoyable and comfortable.

Balat is absolutely stunning and so is Beglu’s apartment.
I enjoyed wooden decor and beautiful view off the balcony on the second floor sipping local turkish wine and enjoying the local neighborhood views.
kitchen have all the amenities you might think of. clean, extra cozy and definitely lots of character compared to similar looking hotels.
The apartment is located few blocks away from Balat’s main street - so it’s quite when you sleep and yet it’s just few minutes away from all the beautiful things this neighborhood has teo offer. Lots of coffee shops (i swear, it’s countless), tea bars, coziest looking food spots, antique stores and bits of local designer little shops was so fun to explore!
We mostly took a cab to the city center - the price varies from 100-375 liras depending on traffic and my mood to negotiate lol - but it’s also walking distance if you like the walk! it took me around 30 mins from historical center and probably 1,5-2 hours when i took local winding paths across neighborhood.

Beglu's apartment was so cosy, clean and beautifully decorated. We enjoyed breakfast on our balcony the most. The kitchen was very well-stocked with spices and oils. making simple meals was easy. Rooms and beds were very comfy. Apartment was in a nice neighbourhood and near amenities, cafes and shops. loved the hood of Balat.. Only a 12 min walk from ferry terminal Fener, easily accessible by bus. Only 1 thing to note is that if you're here with heavy suitcases, be prepared to lug them up a very steep staircase. Highly recommend. Apartment is even nicer than the pics!

Everything about this place is perfect. Starting with a location in Balat that is close to touristic area of Balat, but at the same moment in authentic neighborhood. we were so impressed with area, that basically didn't want to leave it and see main attractions and rather spend most of the time wondering around the neighborhood.
The apartment itself is absolutely beautify decorated (even took pictures to use some ideas for my home :-)) and moreover has everything in it (for cooking, washing, ironing and so on and so on). Moreover there is amazing balcony with a view on church and surrounding houses.
One small minus, that is rather about personal preferences, is that AC is only in living room on second floor, bedrooms have only fans, might be not an issue for people used to live in hot countries, but for us was a nit difficult to sleep (came in August, so most hot time of the year).
Owner is the best :-)

Quaint house with lots of artefacts. Decently located for the main attractions. Many eating places and grocery stores near by. Comfortable bed and clean linen. Great balcony for relaxed evenings. Well appointed kitchen. We enjoyed our stay.

description:
Our location is very near to Galata Tower , İstiklal avenue and Galataport.Subway is only 2 minutes walking distance.There are many touristic restaurants and attractions .
Our flat is newly designed and have every equipment in it you will need.

reviews.text:
Apartment was clean and match with photos.
Extremely close to Galat tower, lots of restaurants and walking streets, metro tram and bus stop about 10-15 minutia low speed walking
Washing machine was broken but the host react quick and repair on the next day.
AC and heating mode work fine.
High floor without elevator was difficult with baggage and kids.
Without microwave was highly hard to eat inside the apartment.
Good apartment if you’re without kids and big stuff

We stayed for 4 nights
Pros:
- location (next to gala tower)
- big and comfy beds
- hot water
- fully equipped kitchen
Cons:
- 3rd floor, no elevator
- balcony a bit dirty
Overall good price/quality.
Recommended

Very convenient location close to Galata Tower. The street itself is very hilly and constantly blocked as it has a lot of construction stores dropping and picking up stock. The flat was very comfortable and quiet at night, although it could do with some repairs. The balcony isn't really usuable as there isn't any furniture and the flooring was extremely dirty and dusty which I cleaned up. The hosts were very responsive and allowed us to store our baggage close by after check out which was great. Overall decent value for money.

Terrific place to land with quick, walkable access to Galata Kulesi (Tower), Modern Art Museum and bridge crossings toward Habia Sofia etc.. Half a block uphill is a lively pedestrian-only area in the evenings, and above that is an even more lively neighborhood. One drawback to this location on workdays is that it is along a 2-block single lane working street (Trades-people, industrial shops, lighting shops, etc.) I had a bit of angst when in a hurry to get somewhere: my taxi got stuck between two small trucks that were loading / unloading materials. A simple work-around was to walk to the end of the street. Not an issue on the weekend.
After climbing 3 flights of stairs, the apartment appeared largely as advertised. Could use more closet space for extended stays, and a Microwave with some more basics (sugar, paper towels, perhaps water, since one doesn't drink Turkish tap water)
Host was accessible easily. Could potentially offer a book of local recommendations?
Thanks!

Pictures are somehow reflecting the reality .. the place clean and just next to Galata tower … easy access and close to metro and other public transportation , restaurants supermarkets and Isteqlal street . There are only one AC in the apartment in one of the bedrooms but u the ceiling is equipped with a fan … faced an issue with the shower heater and they were fast to respond .. sinks in the bathroom and toilet a little bit smelly and if u are coming with a big suitcase then definitely u are gonna struggle to carry it all the way up until u reach the apartment .. I recommend this place .

description:
This is a private room in an apartment. I live in the same apt. and there are three more rooms for Airbnb guests, and there are cats living with us. 🐱

The room has a Bosphorus view by windows. There is a double bed, a study table, a clothe hanger, a dresser and a seat in the room. It gets lots of sunlight.

The apt. is in Baltalimanı. It is 7 min. away from seaside by walking. It is on the hill. It has a terrace with amazing Bosphorus view.

Taksim Square is 40 min. by public transport.

reviews.text:
My gosh, what a great place this is. Where to begin: the room is big and comfortable, with a nice bed, a nice desk for working, enough floor space to do yoga, a great view. I felt comfortable to make sounds in there and was never disturbed by other people's sounds (though I sleep with earplugs, so I may not be the best reference for this). There are a few other rooms being rented out and every guest was a great person. I'd meet them in the shared kitchen which had everything, (even a nice big stock pile of dry goods left by other guests), or out on the deck which has such a great view of the Bosphorus it made me laugh out loud at my good fortune when I first saw it. I highly recommend this place for an individual or a couple.
Everything was kept super clean as well and the host was available and very helpful when I needed something.

I was initially super excited to be staying at this location based on the photos and the reviews, however when I got there everything exceeded my expectations! The view is beyond a dream come true, the rooftop is lush and the room is spacious and comfortable. Mertby is a wonderful host and the rest of the housemates are welcoming, easy to talk to and helpful. The location is near the coast so perfect for morning runs or late-night walks and it is also close to shops, restaurants and public transport.

This place was great to stay! If I ever come back to Istanbul, this will be the place I stay. I recommend you stay here. It is private, quiet, great view. I extended my stay twice. The room is very spacious. Mertbey is courteous, polite, nice and friendly. It is easy to get around the city by using the buses near by (just a 5-10 min walk from the home). Bed is comfortable, slept very well. The view to the Bosporus is amazing. The kitchen has may items for cooking, I was able to do my laundry (washer/dryer) here as well.
I recommend this place!
Ev temiz ve düzenliydi. İhtiyacım olan temel eşyalar mevcuttu. Konumu da oldukça uygundu. Ev sahibi iletişime açıktı ve yardımcı oldu. Genel olarak memnun kaldım, teşekkür ederim.

Loved the views at night, the hospitality, the cats! Felt right at home among the little feline friends. Kitchen is a little small and there is only one bathroom + toilet do occasionally the wait for one’s turn became a little tedious if another guest needed to take their time. But personally I didn’t mind too much. It was a very pleasant stay and the room was spacious, cozy, and felt like a little home away from home. With my car rental I was able to park comfortably nearby on the street.

description: Enjoy easy access to historical places, popular stores, and restaurants from this charming accommodation.

reviews.text: great stay! the host is very responsive and very helpful, probably the best part about this trip. the hotel is located within walking distance from all major tourist directions. it is located at a hill which means walking up the hill quite a few times. it's important to know that the hotel doesn't have a list and it is four floors with a terrace situated at the very top. beautiful views. the hotel is well priced. the host allowed us to leave our luggage safely with him post check out.

Perfect! Worth the price. Everything was clean, and there was room cleaning on our 3rd day. Everyone is super kind and helpful with any information. Got free water, 2am check in, carried our suitcases, gave recommendations, had all amenities, balcony with view of the sultanahmet mosque which was super beautiful both during the day & even nicer at night, theres a rooftop terrace with a superb view over Istanbul and the sea and the sunset. Was overall more than expected!
Clean, specious and comfortable room. Great location to discover Istanbul. Helpful host and reception staff. I would recommend!

My daughter and I were traveling in Istanbul together and were a little nervous being so female tourists. VersecaHotel surpassed all of our expectations. The host was probably the most responsive host we’ve ever had. We felt comfortable and most importantly safe. We didn’t feel uncomfortable at all walking around at 11pm to midnightish. The room was spotless and you could not beat the location! It was walking distance to everything. The only thing I regret is not visiting the roof top patio earlier. It was a great place to take our carry out dinner to while watching the sunset. We intend to visit again in the spring with our whole family. Thank you for your hospitality and such an incredible visit.

My stay was absolutely amazing! The place was incredibly clean—spotless, in fact. They provided slippers, shampoo, and soap, and even offered turnover service, which made the experience even better. The service was exceptionally attentive, and the owner/host was fantastic. He personally ensured someone was there to greet us when we arrived close to 11 PM, which was greatly appreciated.
My room had a balcony with an incredible view of the Blue Mosque—it was breathtaking! The building also has a rooftop where you can sit and sip your coffee while enjoying the view. The bathroom and overall space are modern, beautifully renovated, and felt exceptionally clean.
The location is perfect—very central, near the train, plenty of restaurants, shops, and within walking distance of many historical monuments and landmarks. I also felt completely safe in the neighborhood, which made my stay even more enjoyable. Truly a great experience—highly recommend!

description:
This suite has a private kitchenette and a modern bathroom with a jacuzzi. The suite has very large windows, a spacious and useful layout. There is a room cleaning service every 3 days. You can reach historical places from our building in a 10-minute walk and visit the historical places of the old city and shop.
The Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Topkapı Palace are some of them. The tram stops are about a 7-8 minute walk away.

reviews.text:
the photos are more like glamour shots of the room, the actual place is much smaller than it seemed in pictures, not nearly as bright. the host told me it's 35 to 40 sqm when the entire place is ~25 sqm at best. To call it a studio, it means all standard hotel rooms can be called a studio. The reason I book on airbnb is to have a nice spacious unit, which this place at 25sqm (~269 sqft) is not. The price I was paying (us$97/night including all fees for Istanbul in Dec is on the high end) along with the claimed room size plus the good reviews made me believe it must be a nice big place, and I was solely disappointed.
The only saving grace was that Agia was apologetic for exaggerating the room size unintentionally and was cooperative to allow me shorten my stay to 1 night, with cleaning fee my 1 night cost me $109, but I didn't hesitate to move out. The building and surroundings are not flattering either. If you are a light sleeper, be aware of some honking and human noise at night.

Stayed here for 5 nights, was exactly as the pictures had described/showed. Could have been a tiny bit cleaner in some places like the bath had some stains from previous stays and limescale, blinds need a bit of maintenance as sunlight kept coming in through cracks.
Water wasn’t working due to emergency work nearby, we were kept in the loop by the host when it would turn back on, great communication, they also sorted us out with the transfer to and from the airport which was of great help.
Would highly recommend a stay here as it is very close to the main areas only reason it didn’t get a 5 stars was due to the tiny issues I mentioned above.

The location and comfort of this apt was perfect. The space was open and clean and the hosts were always there to answer any questions. I would stay here again! Such a cool little flat with an 8-12 minute walk to the grand bazaar! Everything was as pictured! Thank you Agia for your kindness 🙏
Amazing stay, pictures were exactly as described, host was extremely helpful, definitely recommend staying here, everything’s very accessible from location, definitely would stay here again

It was a great location and easy check in! There were a just few things to note. The AC leaked and they came to fix it the next day but it started leaking again after a bit of use. The bed sheets had a little stain on it and the kettle was not cleaned at all. Overall, it was fine for our two day stay.

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit. It is the most special and popular neighborhood of the city. It is on the street where there are expensive hotels. There are many luxury hotels across the building, the name of the hotel is Princly.

reviews.text:
Meeting Mr. Hakan was the luckiest thing for me in Istanbul.!👍🏻
He is so kind and gentle. We chatted a lot together. He always listened patiently and expressed some objective views. He also recommended me nearby restaurants, which are cheap and delicious！🥰
His apartment is in a great location in the city center, and I can easily go anywhere in Istanbul anytime. 😊
His clean and tidy room gave me a great living experience, I feel living here is more comfortable than the luxury hotel opposite. 🤫
In the whole of Istanbul, there is no better value option than Mr. Hakan's room!
Thank you very much for everything and hope to see you again!❤️

Everything is exactly like described and hakan is a great host.
I just wished if there was a key for the room but for my luck the other guests were polite and trustful.
The location is more than perfect for a tourist you can go literally everywhere from there easily.
just a key for the room and that will be 200%
Thank you Hakan❤️
hakan is a very welcoming host and the bed was very comfortable. it's right in the heart of nisantasi and a short walk to taksim.

Hakan abi çok misafirperver ve güzel insandır. Güzel sohbetleri var, sıkılmazsınız. Evin konumu çok rahat bir yerde. Metroya 3 dakika mesafededir. Ev temiz ve düzenlidir. Pişman olmazsınız, emin olun.

Hakan is a wonderful, nice, helpful and interesting host;) The room was wonderful with all the amenities. The location of the accommodation is exceptional, the value for money is perfect!
Parfait logement, idéal si vous êtes de passage. Harkan est juste parfait !
Просто замечательный человек и отличное место!

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. 150 meters from Taksim Square. Very close to public transportation. Our house is pleasant and spacious in the middle of shopping, dining, entertainment and historical places. All your needs are available in the house and in the kitchen. While exploring Istanbul, you can relax in the garden and have your drinks.

reviews.text:
We had an amazing 6 day stay at Elif’s two-bedroom unit—perfect for our family with teenagers! Elif was a fantastic host, always responsive and helpful, even helping with our airport transfer for an stress-free experience.
The location was unbeatable—just a 5-minute walk to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street, yet on a quiet, safe street. Our teens loved being so close to shops and restaurants, while tours and transport were easily accessible. The area felt welcoming, with a bakery nearby for breakfast, a kebab restaurant for lunch, and plenty of charm.
The unit was clean, cozy, and family-friendly, with a handy kitchen for quick meals and plenty of hot water for everyone. The backyard cats were a hit with the kids, adding a homely touch. We even found ourselves chilling with Netflix before bed a few nights.
Elif’s place is ideal for families, groups, or solo travelers seeking a comfortable and convenient stay in Istanbul. Highly recommend—and we can’t wait to return!

This house is exactly how it is mentioned . Literally 400 mtr to taksim square . Metro is also there . But the tram station is a little far . 15 minutes by walk . House is very neat and clean . Elif is so proactive . Very helpful . House is very much value for money . Clean beds and cute house . There are cutleries and crockeries available too . Thank you for the coffee powder too . I shall definitely recommend the house to others who wish to stay near taksim

We were travelling in a group of 5 adults (elderlies) and Elif’s place was comfortable to all of us. Worth to note that the house is about 5 minutes mini uphill walk to Taksim Square & Istiklal Street, so for my group of elderlies, it is a bit of a hike. However, throughout the walk, plenty of restaurants & groceries stores you can stop by, which is great. The house is located on ground floor, but requires you to walk up 2-3 mini stairs to enter the house. Each room is spacey enough for you to unload 2-3 size medium size luggage bags. Both hot and cold water available at all times. Overall, I would recommend to stay Elif’s place again if you’re visiting Istanbul with a group of young adults.

i was wishing for staying more than 2 days but the place is full. the apartmant itself is soo good, they even have a complete seasoning at the kitchen (how thoughtfull!), amenities at bathroom, towel, dishwasher and even toys for children. the place is clean and smell good! accessible for travelers with a huge luggage, children and elders. Walk distance from taksim, metro and busses! a lot of option for transportation. Elif is indeed have a good taste in interior design, have good skill of communication and very helpfull for all things we need. i recomended this stays to all my friend and relatives to visit her place whenever they come to istanbul. Thankyou elif! 🫶🏻

This apartment is just off Taksim Square, which is very central with plenty of public transport links to anywhere in Istanbul.
The flat was in a quiet street but in easy walking distance to restaurants. and supermarkets.
The flat was on the ground floor, so easy access and had a small private courtyard out back for sitting in for some private time outside in the evening.
The flat has mosquito screens, all the windows opened to allow a through draught and there was a brilliant AC unit for those hotter nights.
Elif left us plenty of drinking water, more than we needed for the four nights we were there. We didn't use the kitchen other than the kettle so can't comment on cooker, however a nice surprise was that the Washing machine was a washer/dryer. We went out and put our washing in and came back to it all clean and dried.
There were a few cosmetic things that needed fixing, hence the overall 4 star review, however the price was very reasonable and we would definitely rebook.

description: In this house, I wanted to prepare a fun room for my young guests who come to visit Turkey. The location of the apartment is wonderful, the room is on the 5th floor, although this is a difficult detail for the stairs, it has the comfort of being on the last floor.

reviews.text: I stayed for a few days at the place and very much enjoyed the location of it. It's close to the ferry and bus stations and there's many restaurants, shops nearby. The studio itself had all the essentials for a short-term stay. However, u must be prepared to climb the stairs as the studio is located on the 5th floor with no elevator. The apartment was clean-ish, there were ants and bugs from the humidity. Also, the pressure in the shower was meh. But it's a budget friendly place, so I can't complain really. Besides, the host was nice and let me check out later which was much appreciated.

A nice cozy apartment in the middle of kadiköy. it's very quiet and comfortable. Everything was clean and in good condition. The host was very responsive and helpful.
Only a couple of things - the flat is on the 5th floor and without an elevator and the water pressure is barely manageable.

Great location in the heart of kadakoy. WiFi was decent, air-con worked well, rooms were clean and comfortable, host was friendly and responsive.
Recommended.

Gerçekten çok beğendik, biz girmeden temizlik yapılmış, çok rahattı. Her yere çok yakın ve yürüme mesafesinde alt sokağında kahvaltı mekanları mevcut. Biz şahsen bir sonraki sefere tekrar aynı yerde kalmayı düşünüyoruz. Fiyatını gerçekten son kuruşuna kadar hak ediyor. Tuğba hanım da çok nazik ve kibardı teşekkür etmek istiyorum burdan da

This place has a great location in Kadiköy. It is close to Hava bus stop, to the metro station, and to the ferry station. It is within the walking distance to Moda, yet the street is pleasantly quiet. The apartment matches the photos and has everything one needs. The co-host is lovely and responsive, she was available and really helpful. The check-in went smoothly, although you might ask for your Ap number in advance. Also do not miss the key box: it is on the ground floor, in the corner as you turn left. I totally enjoyed my stay! Something to be aware of is the 5th floor to climb with your baggage - make sure you are fit enough! And a few red ants that might climb on the bed and make you uncomfortable. Rather than that the place completely met my expectations.

description:
Welcome to a stay at an apartment in a newly renovated historical building , which faces the historical tourist attraction of ISTANBUL "Galata Tower" ( From were you can have a breath-taking 360 degree view of ISTANBUL ) This apartment is centrally located next to major tourist attractions , right in the center of Istanbul.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Home away from home" from the moment you step in.

reviews.text:
We recently had the pleasure of staying at Tevfik's place and we must say it was an amazing experience!
The apartment is located in a great area and looks exactly as in the photos. Very beautifully furnished, cozy, spacious place, well-maintained and clean. The attention to detail was evident in every corner, from the stylish decor to the comfortable amenities provided. The reliable Wi-Fi connection was also a bonus. Situated right next to the Galata Tower, this place offered easy access to popular attractions, restaurants, and public transportation.
The host was incredibly accommodating and responsive throughout our stay. They provided clear instructions on the self-check-in process and checked us in earlier.
Overall, we highly recommend this place! This is among the best Airbnb places we've ever rented and we would be definitely looking to book it again in the future!
Thanks, Tevfik and Cagil!

The apartment is in front of Galata Tower, has elevator, it is very safe, super clean and has everything that we needed for our stay. Very similar to a hotel service. Everything looks as described in the pictures. They welcome us with a bottle of wine. And the Co-host was a great communicator and professional when we had any questions. I highly recommend this place for two people. We had a very pleasant stay and we definitely plan to return soon. Thank you for everything.

Great clean apartment in the middle of galata. Tevfik was super responsive and extremely accommodating! The wifi is a bit dodgy but they brought us a mini hotspot which was great! Home is super clean and new! They have an elevator which is fantastic! Definitely a high traffic area but easy to get to everywhere!
Clean and comfortable place for short and long stay. It has everything you need for your stay. There is convenient paid parking within walking distance. Check-in is quick and easy.

Clean, modern, and right at the Galata Tower. My wife and I stayed at this beautiful apartment for five nights, and this is the best I have ever stayed in for the past five years. The apartment is spacious, with a large living room and a kitchenette. The shower room is decent and clean with two sets of bath towels and hand towels provided. The bedroom is a good size with a comfortable bed and very quiet. Cagil, the coworker of Tevfix, was super responsive. Nothing is too much for her. We would like to thank the host and all of his staff, especially the housekeeping lady, for being flexible with the early arrival. I was so surprised that the apartment building was right at the entrance of the Galata Tower and in the center of all the main tourist attractions around the area. Fantastic experience and I strongly recommend this apartment.

description: Monnas’ Rooms was founded with the dream of being a guest in your unique stories to be created in matchless places. We wanted to narrete our rooms by taking inspiration from women who shaped the history with their existences, thus creating living spaces to make your visit even more memorable for our guests. Because we are well aware of how much our experience would be enriched, when we all have a room of our own.

reviews.text: Nice place, and very well located - walking distance from Taksim square and some nice local cafes are close by. The supermarket at the building entrance is also very handy. The flat was clean and spacious and the beds were very comfortable. The road is fairly quiet but is close to all the action so overall is well located. The apartment is one of several in the building “apart hotel” so you have a card to access the building and then a key to access your private apartment. Good value for money overall and well recommended. Emre was helpful, responsive and also a nice guy!

Clearly a 5-star recommendation. The appartment is spacious and very tastefully and modernly furnished. Everything is exactly as shown in the photos, actually even more beautiful. The host welcomed us with exceptional friendliness and helpfulness and was always available to answer our questions. The apartment is located in a quiet side street without traffic noise, but with a small supermarket in the basement, which has a good assortment. The location of the apartment is also otherwise ideal; central sights are in the distance of a nice walk through the city. Various restaurants, cafes and bars are in the immediate vicinity. A very good choice!

The apartment is in a very nice location. 5-minute walk to Taksim Square. There is a supermarket downstairs which is really nice. The neighborhood is nice and safe. There are very nice places close by for incredible Turkish breakfast. Emre is a super nice host. He helps you with the check-in and is always responsive. He also allowed us to leave our luggage there after we checked out for a few hours which helped us a lot.
The house is clean and nice. However, 2 of the rooms don't have windows and can become a little warm. Overall, I really really recommend this place.

The location of the hotel is very good, right in the middle of Cihangir which is walking distance of Taksim. When we arrived it was really late but the check-in was done quick and simple even then. The apartment had all essentials and was really clean when we arrived. We would definetely stay here again as we were always greeted with a smily and helpful owners/staff. Thank you Monnas 🙏
Konumu güzel, temiz fotoğraflardaki gibi daire. Emre’de iyi bir ev sahibi. Hiç bir problem yaşamadık ve son derece memnun kaldık. Teşekkürler Emre görüşmek üzere

description:
Welcome to your spacious & bright luxury home in the heart of the city!

Minutes away from the bosphorus, İstinye Park, Türkiye Tenis Federasyonu, Maslak, Acıbadem Maslak, the American Consulate and Enka, this 180m2 3BD/2 fully & newly furnished home from has a 150m2 terrace that oversees the gorgeous condo pool and a 50m2 garden w/ a hammock. The garden door opens to a yard leading to building amenities (large BBQ, playground, tennis/basketball/football,pool/jacuzzi&gym)!

reviews.text: Convenient location especially if one has a car (free private indoor/outdoor parking available). Very receptive host promptly responding to messages/concerns. Apartment adequately equipped/furnished (though somewhat dated). Showers/bathrooms can benefit from a renovation redo. Stayed during fall so cannot comment on what options are there for AC. Overall pleasant stay.

Kızım, ablam ve eşim evimizin tadilatı esnasında planlar karışınca bu güzel evde birkaç günlük konaklama fırsatımız oldu.
Ev çok zevkli şekilde dekore edilmiş ve herşey yepyeni, mutfaktaki çoğu şeyi ambalajından ilk biz çıkardık. Girişte bizi su, çikolata, lokum, greta, kolonya, kahve ve çaydan oluşan güzel bir hoşgeldiniz paketi bekliyordu. Deterjandan, yatakların rahatlığına ve ingilizce/türkçe kitaplara kadar her detay düşünülmüş.
Sayıca fazla olduğumuzdan ötürü başta banyolar ile ilgili olan bir önceki yoruma istinaden tedirginlik yaşadım ama Alara Hanım iki banyonun da tamamen elden geçtiğini belirtti. Gerçekten de öyleydi ve sıfır olan mutfak, mutfak eşyaları, yepyeni olan kurutma makinesi ile çamaşır makinesi ve duşa ilişkin kullanma talimatları da çok kolaydı.
Evde birçok yemek masası ve koltuk olması da özellikle de herkes biraz başını dinlemek istediğinde oldukça fazla işe yaradı :)
Geldiğimizde hava çoğunlukla yağmurluydu ama o zaman bile bahçenin ve verandanın üstü kapalı olan kısımları çok keyifliydi. Sanki şehrin içinde bir ormanda yaşıyormuşsunuz gibiydi! Ayrıca ev yerden ısıtmalı ve çok geniş ve bol camlı olmasına rağmen baya ısınıyor. Dereceyi de kendiniz ayarlayabiliyorsunuz.
Son olarak, arabayla geldiğimiz için hem kapalı hem de açık otopark seçenekleri işimize yaradı. İstinye Park’a ve sahile birer kez yürüdük, onun dışında çoğu yere arabayla gitmeyi tercih ettik.
Alara Hanım’a ilgisi, misafirperverliği ve her konuda bize çok hızlı geri döndüğü için çok teşekkürler. Eşe dosta söyledik bile!
Nice and clean apartment in a good location. I highly recommend this place. The host alara is friendly

This was the most beautiful apartment in Istanbul we had stayed so far. It was nice to see how our 85-year old Mom enjoyed sitting outside at the terrace breathing fresh air. The apartment is large and our company of 4 adults all have private space))
The apartment was sparklingly clean and the communication with Alara was quick and efficient. Alara is a wonderful host, she was always in touch with us.
We highly recommend this apartment to all travelers and we ourselves will stay here again with a great pleasure

What a hidden gem, in the city center but also with a garden and soo spacious 🏡 we almost never used the main door and always entered the house from the garden door instead. Also the house was even better than pictured during booking w/ a/cs in all bedrooms, a brand new refrigerator and sofa. Thanks for everything!

description:
Amasing sea and city view with brand new Italian interior and fully luxury furnished ! Akmerkez Shopping Mall accross- Best Location, in the middle of posh luxury spots. Metro station is just next to building, free vale parking, very big living room,
fully furnished brand new kitchen, 1 balcony, 4 bedrooms , every bedroom has queen beds for 2 people and big closets, 3 bathrooms brand new. For better feeling watch apartment video : AKMERKEZ LIVING ROOM & KITCHEN

reviews.text:
Banu and Arzu are amazing amazing hosts and people. My family and I went from a disaster airbnb situation to being saved by our angels Arzu and Banu. We felt completely at home. The apartment was set up of for us so easily with everything you can think of at your disposal. They even went out of their way to purchase us a crib and high chair for our baby, we are so grateful for them!!! They made us feel welcomed and took care of us like we were their family.
The apartment is top notch, you get exactly what you see with the absolute best location. It’s beautifully designed with high quality taste and has remarkable views. Some nights we didn’t even want to leave the apartment because it was so comfortable! You walk out your door and have easy access to everything. It’s also a great and central place to access many parts of Istanbul easily.
The building staff is also extremely nice and helpful. Banu and Arzu you are the absolute BEST!! We can’t wait to come back to our home!

Apartmen has a magnificent view, I got so amazed by the view!!! The decoration of the apartment is also so unique and luxury!!! Very well furnished with a luxury taste!!! All furnitures are brand new too!!! I also love bahtrooms and kitchen where you have all equipments!!!
Apartment is exactly the same as it looks from the pictures!!! Bedrooms are big and so comfortable!!! It is a very beautiful and elegant apartment that I highly recommend!!! Apartment has a great location, just 2-3 minutes away to all trendy restaurants. I am definitely very looking forward to staying again for sure!

It was great, 5 stars!
First, very big panthouse with an amasing view.
Super luxury style furnished, marble floors, bathrooms are very chich, 4 bed rooms are so big , well furnished too.
Kitchen is great and fully equiped.
No need to tell about the location, in the middle of posh neighboorhood, just opposite of Istanbul best shopping mall, metro and taxi station is just in front of the building, surronded by luxury cafes , shops and restaurants, world famous Nusret Salt Bea is just 2 minutes walk away.
Building management great too! Security, free valet parking , etc.
Definetly, the best airbnb apartment I have stayed so far, whenever I come back to Istanbul, this is our must apartment from now on.

The place is very centrally located. Close to a lot of restaurants, shops and the metro for easy access to rest of the city.
The apartment is spacious, nicely decorated and has all the amenities one might need. The kitchen is big if you wanted to cook rather than eat at the restaurants available. There are 3 bathrooms and 4 bedrooms, making it easy to accommodate a large group.
Its easy to communicate with Arzu and she makes check in and the stay process very easy.
Would definitely recommend for anyone looking for a central stay in Istanbul!

Like a hotel! Stunning view and style, best location! In overall, apartment is so luxury and brand new, all furnitures, marbles are so stylish. Definitely the best and the most luxury airbn apartment i ever seen!!! Very well furnished kitchen has all equipments. I definitely love this panthouse and highly recommend it for sure! The location is the best of the best even you dont need a taxi to go to the trendy top restaurants and clubs, shopping mall, just 3 -5 minutes walking away, everywhere is walking distance!

description: Boasting a private entrance, this air-conditioned apartment includes a kitchen, 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer. In the kitchen, guests will find a stovetop, a refrigerator, kitchenware and a tea and coffee maker. Featuring a terrace with city views, this apartment also offers soundproof walls and a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. The unit has 2 beds.

reviews.text:
Best location and hospitable host😀 Everything is very clean and comfortable
Be careful, quite a steep spiral staircase

sınavım olduğu için eve giriş saati 2den önce girmek istediğimi daha önceden bildirmiştim ev sahibi yardımcı olacağını söylemişti. Konaklama günü 12de yazdım 2.30a kadar cevap vermedi. En son eve gidip mahallede şans eseri temzilik görevlisiyle karşılaşınca apartmana girebildik. Çalışan kapalı hizmetçi çok kabaydı kalacağımız odayı temizlememişti. Neden temizlemediniz rezarvasyon saatimiz geçti diye sitem etmeme dalga geçer gibi bilmiyorum niye yapmadım dedi.Bekleyin temizlicem dedi o soğukta 1 saate yakın bir de odanın temizlenmesini bekledik. Odayı temizleyip gitmiş bize gelip temizledim bile demedi. Saat 4e doğru bu muammeleden sıkılıp iptal başvurusu yaptıktan sonra ev sahibi benle en sonunda iletişime geçti :) Saat 5 gibi girdiğim odaya sonradan alacaklı gibi temizlik görevlisini gönderdi. Banyodaydım. Kapıyı vurup duruyordu müsait değilim diyince de birden gitti. Pardon kusura bakmayın iyi günler gibi kelimeleri hiçbiri öğrenememiş rezalet kötüydü .oda da çok soğuk yatak kırıktı

Sıcak suyun gelmemesi gibi ufak aksaklıklar yaşasak da bildirdiğimiz an çabucak halledildi. Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi her mesajıma anında cevap verdi. Konum merkezi olmasına rağmen yalıtımı iyiydi dışarıdan çok ses gelmiyordu içeriye. Dairenin dizaynı çok hoşuma gitti zaten bu sebeple burayı seçmiştim. Mutfakta her türlü araç gereç vardı işimizi gördü. Benim için tek sıkıntı duştan çıktığımda oda soğuk geldiği için klimayı açmak istedim fakat klima çalışmıyordu. Üşümemek için sıkı giyinmem gerekti. Bunun dışında bir sıkıntı yaşamadık biz. Genel olarak çok güzel bir deneyimdi.

Fantastic stay at Lashar's place. The flat is in a good location and very comfortable bed.
Really good value for money. Thanks Lashar

İçeride üstünkörü temizlik yapılmıştı (yatağın altı vs. Temizlenmemiş, duvar kenarları gibi bazı yerlerde örümcek ağları ve tozlar vardı) ve yatağın altında görmek istemeyeceğiniz bir çöp bırakılmıştı. Bunların dışında ev sahibi sorulara hızlı yanıt verdi kapıda bekleme gibi bir sorun olmadı konumu gayet ideal ve caddeye çok uzak olmayan yerdeydi. Odanın içi kullanışlıydı

description:
Our house, located on the side street of the Gazhane Museum, which hosts 2 theaters and unique exhibitions, has a separate entrance. The street is perfectly safe. Our apartment, which has a closed balcony and plenty of plants, is spacious for a 1+1 structure.
No smoking in the house. You can smoke on the balcony with the balcony windows open, making sure the doors are closed.
Metrobus and Marmaray are 8-9 minutes on foot from the house.

reviews.text: We stayed at Banu's place for a month and could not have been more comfortable. Her place was super clean, spacious, and located near buses, metro, restaurants, etc. Banu was really helpful and always responded right away when I had a question. She also came over to meet us and had a nice visit. The place was well appointed for long stays, too. The kitchen was well equipped and there was ample space to work.

Banu's flat was a very spacious, comfortable home with all main amenities available for use and in a great location. Banu is a proactive host who makes herself available whenever required and tries her best to give you a stay worth your money. Unfortunately there was an issue with the WiFi on the providers end, for our whole stay. Banu tried her best to resolve this but ultimately could not. Instead she covered the costs of us buying data throughout our stay.
Local shops are nearby, and there are lots of transportation routes available.
We had a lovely stay :)

Banu is an excellent host, she provided very clear and detailed instructions and was in touch with us the whole time. The apartment is spacious and cozy, equipped with everything we needed. Everything was clean. The location is also great, walking distance to public transportation and Kadikoy. The only thing is, it is a bit dark in the bedroom and kitchen because there is no daylight in those rooms, but it’s not that important. Overall, it was a great experience.

I want to cry from how much I loved Banu and how much she did for me and for my experience to be absolutely perfect. To start with, I arrived really late, but Banu’s wonderful husband Zafer was kind enough to wait for me until 3 in the night. Baby’s place is spotless clean, newly refurbished, very spacious. The hot water in the shower runs for as long as you want unlike in many other Turkish apartment. There is a separate room for the kitchen, enough space to place the clothes and put away your suitcase so that they don’t bug the eye. The balcony is huge and extremely comfortable. The apartment is located separately from all the others, there is a private entrance so that gives you extra privacy. There are two very comfortable sofas, huge carpet and a tv that offers all the entertainment you might wish. There is plenty of plants that give an extra cosy vibe to the apartment. The fridge is new and really spacious, you can put all the food you want. I loved Banu and her wonderful family.

What an amazing airbnb in Istanbul! I've stayed here for a month and working remotely in the meantime.
The location is amazing, close to Moda (about 20 min walking) and immediately in front there's a facility where they host small shows, a library for studying and some cafes.
The apartment itself is very well maintained and taken care of. The living room is very big and cozy. The bedroom is big as well and the bed is very comfortable. The kitchen has all the things you're gonna need.
During summer the apartment never gets too warm which is very good (stayed in june).
Finally the host is incredible! She's always replying very fast and helping you with any request you might have, definitely contributed to make our stay very comfortable!

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay at this apartment, and it was worth the money . The host was extremely fast in responding to questions and was willing to help at all times . The apartment is VERY close to the Yenikapi metro station, and within 8-10mins, walk to Aksaray . There are tons of restaurants , shops, and street markets in this area. I felt safe at all times in the apartment and around the neighborhood. Host left complimentary drinks , ice , very clean sheets and towels, kitchen utensils, which was very appreciated . The apartment was very quiet and peaceful. The only con was the bathroom and the stairs, which is small and may not be suitable for plus-size individuals or comfortable for moving luggage. I will stay again and highly recommend this place.

Review for [Host's Name or Apartment Name]:
We stayed at this apartment during the 2024 Christmas holidays and had a pleasant experience. The host was incredibly friendly and always quick to respond, which made our stay hassle-free.
The apartment is exactly as described: a small, simple space that is perfect for sleeping but not much else. It was warm and comfortable, with hot water available 24/7, which was very convenient during the winter.
The password lock system was a great touch, making check-in and access easy. The location is well-connected, with plenty of transportation options nearby. However, we did feel uneasy walking around the neighborhood, particularly at night. While we didn’t encounter any issues, we chose to remain cautious.
Overall, this apartment is ideal for budget travelers who need a basic place to rest after exploring the city. We appreciated the host’s hospitality and enjoyed our trip to Istanbul.

The place looks quite different from the pictures. It is small if you are two people planning to stay here. The corridors smelled strongly of smoke and even the room smelled of dampness. While the photos may make the room appear big, it isn't. Even the bathroom is quite small. Mr. Miller is responsive and helpful. So all in all, the host is nice, but the place is small.

All in all great place to stay. Only a few minutes to the train and metro. Restaurants and shops are also near. Bed was nice and comfy and AC worked great. One gripe is the bathroom. Water was unfortunately not warm for long, as the boiler might be undersized, thus only one person can shower and the other has to wait for the water to become warm again. Bathroom in general could need a bit of a lookup but is fine for what it is. In essence I couldn't really complain especially for the price.

The apartment was newly constructed/renovated. Everything including furniture was clean and new.
Felt cozy and comfortable.
The communication was great and he was always available.
I liked the fact the apartment was between main tramway and metro.
Taxi station was very close as well.
It would have been great if they had put an iron and some tea and coffee bags in apartment.
All in all it was a great stay!

description: Apartment is on the 1st floor of the 2floor building, which has acces by car right to the entrance door. Location is great, very easy to visit most of central places by feet or to find a transport. Taxim Sq., Istiklal Ave., Galata Tower, "Taxim" & "Sishane" metro stops, bus stops are in walking distance. Cause of this central location there are many markets, restaurants, pubs, and etc.which are open (7×24) whole day.

reviews.text:
Eltaj was very kind and helpful. He met me to hand over the key and sent over several recommendations for restaurants. I appreciate that the host let me book for the same day after an issue at my last Airbnb.
Pros: Large apartment with nice simple furnishings. Central and close to Istiklal street. Safe and walkable. Close to grocery stores. Full sized fridge with freezer. Strong wifi. Large windows everywhere that provide a good breeze and sunlight. Separate shower area (unlike many apartments with showers directly over the toilet in Istanbul). Washer in unit.
Cons: Kitchen was ill-equipped. The only cooking utensil upon arrival was a soup ladle, although I was later provided with a spatula and wooden spoon. The bathroom window can’t be open while showering as it provides a direct view into the shower. Brightly lit streets that shine into the apartment (Eltaj kindly provided darker curtains for the bedroom after request).
Overall would recommend for weeklong or shorter stays.

Gurubish is the perfect host. She's polite and friendly, she immediately answers all questions and gives you a list of recommendations (to have breakfast or diner, to buy turkish delight etc.).
This apartment is located in a quiet place. There are a lot of grocery stores and local cafes where you can dine in or take away. It's a good place if you want to go sightseeing. For example, it takes like 5 min to get to Istiklal Caddesi or around 15 min to Taksim Square. Also there is a bus stop near the house so you can get everywhere you want to. We bought Istanbulkart at the metro station so we travelled using only public transport.
The apartment was very clean, cozy and well equipped (iron, hairdryer, fridge, washing machine, towels, two kettles, frying pans, cutlery, nice dishes, wine glasses). There is also a tiny balcony but the weather was cold so we didn't spend much time there.
We had a great time living here!

We were happy to stay in this flat.
It is very well located, you can easily walk to Istiklal. Product stores (Carrefour, Şok) are near as well.
The flat is clean and very cute:)
The Internet was fast. There were no problems with water, hitting or something else. There was all the kitchen stuff we needed.
Gurubish and Eltaj were kind and ready to help when we asked.
Highly recommend!)

My experience was not bad at all . Fidan is a good person in communication especially at check in time and she sent us a list of places as recommendation to help us . The place is very enough fir two person and about 300 m from Istklal street and 600 m from Taksim square. The place was clean and well equipped except two things ( it needs curtains to block the sunlight and the place needs air conditioner or even fan in summer times). We asked Fidan for iron she get one for us the day after . One note to take care that there is workshops surrounding that make noise. The area has some weird people at night so any girl being alone just take care of it .

Really cute apartment, more then fair price, really friendly hosts.
Thanks a lot Fidan and Eltaj for the great stay :))

description: Cozy fully restored new flat(first floor) in the historical district on the Bosphorus. it is equipped with fully functional, bar concept kitchen, adult bedroom, first class textile products, 4k smart TV, fiber internet connection, L sofa that can be a full size bed , new and fully functional white goods. . A Bosphorus house in a great location within the historical texture, 200 meters from the sea, 10 minutes walking distance from the metro stations.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay! The apartment is in a great location in Hisarüstü, just a short 5-minute walk to the seaside, which made it very convenient for exploring and relaxing by the water. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for my stay. The host was very welcoming and responsive, which made check-in and communication smooth. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Istanbul and would happily stay here again.

I've been doing Airbnb for 3 years and this was the best experience. Baris is a kind, warm and thoughtful person, helpful and responsive. The place I rented from him has everything: clean, charming, full kitchen, great bed, great shower, great internet, all in hidden gem of a neighborhood. I hope to stay again.

Bariş is very kind and respectfull host. I had some problems with reservation and Mr Bariş was always in touch for resolving problems. During our accomandation he was always in touch. He left every daily needs in flat for free like cofee tea or milk...
Flat was really clean and renewad inside. Not noisy place and close to Bosphorus and second Bosphorus bridge. There is a ramp to bosphorus but very good Bosphorus side for walking and good resturants around. There is a market close to flat for resolving daily needs. Totally I'm thankful and will offer to friends as well.
Barış çok kibar ve saygılı bir ev sahibi. Rezervasyonla ilgili bazı sorunlar yaşadım ve sorunları çözmek için Barış Bey her zaman iletişim halindeydi. Konaklamamız sırasında her zaman iletişim halindeydi. Kahve, çay, süt gibi günlük ihtiyaçları daireye bedava bıraktı...
Daire gerçekten temizdi ve içi yenilendi. Gürültülü olmayan bir yer ve Boğaz'a ve ikinci Boğaz köprüsüne yakın. Boğaz'a giden bir rampa var ama Boğaz
Very convenient, clean and comfortable. Got everything needed for cooking, cleaning and laundry. Location is beautiful. Baris is very responsive and helpful.

I Enjoyed my stay in Sariyer. It surpassed my expectations. Friendly host, he was always responsive to my queries and helped me blend in here. My apartment looked exactly as portrayed in the photos and its proximity to the places nearby matched the ones written on Air bnb. Overall I’d give my experience here a 💯 percent. LOVED IT.

description:
This stylishly designed room is in the center of the city. So you can easily reach historical and shopping places.

This stylishly designed room is in the center of the city. This way, you can easily access historical areas and shopping places.

reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this suite in Istanbul. The booking process was very fast and smooth, and the team was very helpful and cooperative from the beginning.✨
The location is excellent and very strategic. The transportation station is nearby, Galataport is very close, and Taksim is also easily accessible. The building is beautiful, safe, and well located.🌷
A special thank you to the entire team. Everyone was extremely kind, respectful, friendly, and helpful. I truly appreciate their support and kindness during my stay, and I will not forget how they treated me.🌷🌷🫶🏻
The suite was spacious, clean, and comfortable, and the services were good overall. There are only a few small things that could be improved, such as some minor maintenance and better lighting above the mirror in the hallway.
Overall, I had a very good experience and would definitely recommend this place. I’m happy to give it a high rating, and I would gladly stay here again whenever I visit Istanbul.🫰🏻💗

The two guys at the reception we’re very nice and friendly. The accommodation is perfectly located in the middle of the European side and tophane station is a 1 minute walk away.
However because of the central location it’s very loud at night and you can hear everything happening at the main road from noisy cats to cars with loud music playing at 3am.
The room was very spacious but overall it needs to be cleaned better especially the bathroom should be renovated. There were stains on the wall and ground near the bed and a lot of stains across the bathroom walls. The sanitary equipment wasn’t the newest and cleanest.
Regarding the price payed it was ok especially because of the great location but the accommodation could be much better if it would be renovated and cleaned.

Erhan's place was good. The location is excellent and the room has all you need for a short stay. It's more of a hotel type than a regular Airbnb. The pictures are nicer than the actual room due to the quality of finishes and materials used in the renovation. All in all the price, location, 24hr reception are worth it.
Incredible location, lovely bedroom. The bathroom was ok, the shower didn’t really get warm. But overall, it was a very easy check in and we felt very secure. Would stay again.

This apartment is clean and lovely. And the bed is enough bigger than other hotel for two people.
but It's a little far from Tacksim station and an entertainment street.
but the landlord and housekeeper are sooo kind :) so im satisfied with this appartment 😊

description:
Feel at home in my Cozy apt just fully renovated!
Create memories, Keep up the laughs!
1 bedroom, renovated historical apt in central Beyoğlu with its modern and antique mix decor, equipped kitchen, spacious dining area and bright living room with comfy seating . Ideally located in downtown, you’re close to all the best that Istanbul has to offer! the flat is close to Taksim Square, subway, ferry and tram by walk in 8-10 minutes.central but quite&cozy area.

reviews.text:
Cihan's flat was accurately described and displayed in its listing. The location was notably convenient, placed in an area with more locals but in walking distance to the highly sought after, more touristy, Istikal St. area (roughly 8 to 10 minutes). It gave me an experience of being a temporary Turkish resident with great ease of access to more public areas. Cihan's flat was clean (spotless, even) upon entry and truly homey.
Pros: Cihan was tremendously responsive via Airbnb messaging. The hot water gets seriously hot if desired. The building itself is quiet with low traffic. There are local spots such as restaurants nearby.
Cons: The building that houses Cihan's flat and others did not seem to have air conditioning, so it was humid - my stay was in August - during the walk (maybe one minute) upstairs to the flat. Wi-Fi was sometimes spotty in the bedroom, but it worked well in other areas - particularly the living room area.
All in all - a smooth stay and recommended to others!

I had a wonderful stay at Cihan's. She had sent me all the instructions to access the accommodation, which was very convenient. The apartment is even better than in the photos, it is spacious, bright, clean and comfortable. The bed is amazing. The terrace is great for the end of the day with a view of the city. The area is great, it's lively during the day and quiet at night, with restaurants, bars and shops nearby. Everything is accessible on foot and the tram is less than 10 minutes walk to go beyond the Bosphorus. I fell in love with Istanbul and will return to Cihan very soon. In addition, she is a very friendly and responsive host. I 100% recommend this accommodation for a wonderful stay in Istanbul! Thanks Cihan!

This is by far the most desirable location if you are visiting Istanbul as a tourist. Right behind the apartment is the Çukurcuma neighborhood, known for its amazing antique shops. There's also a fancy Turkish bath (hammam) right behind the building. A little further down the road (2 minute walking) is Cihangir, a bourgeois bohemian neighborhood where actors, writers, and musicians live and hang out. Great breakfast places and coffeeshops just a stone's throw away. 2 minutes away from the apartment is also the Istiklal street, the major pedestrian shopping district through which runs a historic tram. The apartment is also about 5 minute walking distance from the tram that takes you to the "historical peninsula" where you can find all the historic Ottoman palaces and mosques. The apartment is as seen in the photos. Very clean and comfortable. While you are in the middle of all the action, the bedroom is facing a quiet street. Cihan is a responsive and helpful host. Highly recommended!

This apartment was so great! Cihan was super communicative, sending detailed check-in instructions with pictures included so I never struggled to find the Airbnb or get in. Additionally, she was very flexible with the time for checking in. Located in the heart of Beyoglu, you are surrounded by the cutest streets with gorgeous cafes and great bars/restaurants in the vicinity. The apartment was very clean, and the living room was spacious with great heating as well. Would love to come back!

very nice and cozy place in a central area but not exactly in the crowd. the area in which it is located is full of nice and cozy bars, not touristic. the host is really kind and always helped us even more than her duties. the flat is new and very clean, the building is typical and very beautiful. definitely worth the price

description: Indulge in ultimate luxury and comfort in our stunning 187 m2 penthouse suite, spread over 2 floors and a breathtaking 48 m2 terrace with an unobstructed view of the Bosphorus. With 3 beautifully appointed bedrooms and two spacious living rooms, this suite offers ample space for you and your loved ones to relax and rejuvenate in style.Experience the epitome of luxury living in our penthouse suite, where every detail is designed to exceed your expectations and create unforgettable memories.

reviews.text:
The apartment is located on the top floor and offers nice views. It’s a bit of a walk to reach nearby restaurants, but manageable. The space itself was roomy and comfortable. Apartment was clean.
There was some initial confusion with the booking , although I had reserved for three guests (the apartment accommodates up to six), the reservation showed only one. Communication with the host involved a bit of back and forth, and I was initially told there would be an extra charge. Fortunately, the issue was resolved at check-in and the additional fee was waived.

I highly recommend Ando Living Airbnb! The location is excellent, about a 15-minute walk to Taksim Square, with beautiful views of the Bosphorus. Check-in was easy, communication was prompt and helpful, and the apartment was spotless, comfortable, and very well maintained.
The apartment had everything I needed for a great stay, and the area felt convenient for exploring Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again on my next visit and would happily recommend it to anyone looking for a great place to stay.

What a nice place. The penthouse was really spacious and had such a great view. The kitchen is nice. I wouldn't want to cook a major meal but for small things it's perfect. Think bachelor Kitchen. Location is nice. Walking is super easy to so many things. Just know that this is city with some pretty major elevation changes. Uber is super easy to utilize. Lastly the staff here is very nice and so accommodating. They were happy to help with everything and also kept the cost down. Something I don't find so often these days. I would return.

It is a beautiful apartment with a really amazing view of Istanbul.
The building itself is clean and modern, with attention to detail and design. It is a big plus to have a doorman throughout the day. Staff were friendly and responsive.
It is just really really unfortunate that the apartment had a strong smell of cigarettes and food (that comes through the vents which is connected to other apartments) throughout the day. The management was proactive and offered me to switch to their 1 bedroom apartment (which was immaculate but didn't have a sea view). I refused as I did want to enjoy the view, which is why I booked this unit in first place. I was told that after me there would be a maintenance done to fix this issue, because besides that it is a really great stay. It just really depends what is important to you.
Easy to get to. Location was good. House was clean with great views. Metro is at the bottom of the hill. Easy access to the city and Uber was easy to get at the location. Enjoyed our stay

description: Asmalımescit is one of the most vibrant and historic districts of Beyoğlu. Just a few steps from our apartment, there are beautiful cafes, restaurants, art galleries and entertainment venues. With its historical texture, colorful streets and central location, Asmalımescit is the perfect starting point to explore Istanbul.

reviews.text:
A stay with some real highlights that need attention
✅ Pros
•Nice location in Istanbul’s old city — perfect for sightseeing
•Bedroom and living room are spacious
•Host Velat was responsive and helpful
❌ Cons
•Surrounding restaurants and cafés play loud music throughout the night till early morning hours .difficult with a toddler at bedtime
•The lift opens directly into the apartment, meaning noise from it during the night disturbs sleep
•The bathroom could use some improvement — it is quite small, and we noticed cleanliness concerns including mold around the wash basin and shower area, along with water drainage issues; managing with a toddler was challenging
•Kitchen is compact and feels quite dated. the utensils and coffee mugs are old and worn, and the overall setup makes it difficult to comfortably prepare even a simple meal or a cup of coffee
💡 Best suited for: Couples or solo travelers. Not for families with children

This place matches the description given. The owner is very responsive to all problems. He is also very friendly. There is a washing machine, kitchen with complete cooking and eating utensils. Spacious bedroom and TV room with beautiful views of the Bosphorus Strait. This apartment is on the 7th floor and has an elevator in the building. Very good location, it is close to Galata Tower, metro station and bus stop. It’s near to Taksim too. Overall is awesome

The apartment looks exactly as at the photos, including the view from the window. Location is perfect, right behind the Istiklaliyyet street, close to the subway and many restaurants nearby. Because of it, can be sometimes noisy in the evenings. The host is very responsive and helpful, ready to arrange anything, communication was quite fast and smooth.

Thanks Velat for hosting us! The view from the apartment is even better than in the pictures. Velat was very friendly, proactive, and always in touch to make sure our stay was comfortable.
The location is fantastic, with plenty of restaurants nearby and easy access to public transportation.
One thing to note: the apartment is in a lively area, so on some nights, there can be street noise from nearby bars until the early morning. It might not be ideal family with young kids, but overall, it was a great experience!

Thank you Velat for an incredible stay. It’s in the perfect location- check in was smooth and easy- he is incredibly responsive should you have any issues
Really I couldn’t fault him- pictures were as described, location was great and he was always offering to help me, even to exchange money to help me with getting the bus back to the airport.
5/5 would recommend. Thanks Velat!

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family.

It is a 5-minute walk to Marmaray, the Ferry and the Coast.
All good restaurants, cafes, bars, concert venues, coastal walking paths are within walking distance.

The kitchen is fully equipped. There's everything you need to help you cook.

There are two sizes of baby beds and a children's room for families with children.

We have a seating area on the balcony.

Three bedrooms, one living room, two toilets, two balconies, spacious, bright, central.

reviews.text:
It is one of our best experience with Airbnb!
I understood that i would love this apartment when i just saw photos. When we checked-in, it was exactly the same as on photos, even more cozy - the living room is so spacious with two big windows - it is what i like, when there is sunlight in a place i live in. There are also three spacious bedrooms so it's convinient for a big family (there is even a cot bed and a lovely crib for newborns). A table with chairs in the balcony is an advantage - you can enjoy a cup of tea or coffe (there is a coffee maschine and a pot).
Other benefits: bed mattress, big wardrobe, washing and dishwashing maschines inside the apart, oven, good drinking water and so on.
Melike and Özgür are hospitable, friendly and lovely people who make your stay in Istanbul a pleasant experience. If you stau here - you will understand what is Airbnb about - unique place with great hosts.
Btw, Moda is the best area in Istanbul - vibrant, good-looking, safe and pleasand to walk

Merhaba;
Bayram sebebi ile 3 gece konakladık. Evin konumu iyiydi otopark problemi dışında,temizlik iyiydi. Fakat hayatımda kaldığım en kötü konaklama tecrübesiydi. Asla uyuyamadık, üst katta sanırım kalabalık bir aile yaşıyor. Gece 2de blender çalıştı, bebeğimiz korkarak uyandı. Üst kat temizliği de aynı saatlerde yapılıyor sanırım. Ev sahibimiz dağda olduğu gerekçesile mesajlarımıza çok geç dönebildi. İyi niyetinden şüphem yok ancak maalesef memnun kalmadık. Ayrıca bu mağrudiyetten dolayı 1 gece iade edeceğim denildi iban istendi bizden (talebimiz olmamasına rağmen) ancak o da gerçekleşmedi.

It's a great apartment with lots of space and so rare to find one with facilities for babies and young children.
There was a problem with the toddler bed which Nesibe offered to fix right away, the hot water didn't run well for a bath and again she offered to fix that.
It is unfortunate that the neighbours are less welcoming to families with young children; a woman shouting upstairs and a heavy smoker downstairs, which comes up through the bathroom vents. As a previous reviewer said, if you keep the door shut, it works. But if you want to give an evening bath to your child, it might not be so pleasant.
That being said, we enjoyed the apartment and it is good value !

Great flat with a lot of rooms and baby stuff! It was great that there was everything you need when you enter the apartment — like soap, washing powder, drinking water, sunflower oil etc. There were no problems with a hot water 👌
We were appreciated how hosts communicated with us!
Sometimes somebody smokes upstairs or downstairs and it feels in the bathroom (we fixed it closing ventilation and closing door to the bathroom).

This location is perfect—just a short walk from both the metro and ferry, and conveniently situated near excellent restaurants and the local market, yet it remains quiet.
Nesibe Melike is incredibly friendly and responsive; we only wish we could have met in person. The apartment is fully equipped for a comfortable stay, and Melike is always ready to assist with anything else you might need.
Will definitely stay here again if I ever revisit Istanbul.

description: Private room for two people with sea views

reviews.text:
Pros:
Water works well once heated — steady and no leaks
Internet is stable
Good location — café downstairs, grocery and nut shop nearby
High ceilings make the space feel open
Bright room without direct sun — great blinds
Air conditioning works
No direct window-to-window view — no need to keep blinds closed
Reasonable price
Things to be aware of:
Mattress is very uncomfortable — the springs are sharp and felt across the entire surface. We had to layer multiple towels just to lie down without pain
Bed headboard is awkward — shelf presses into your neck, sitting up in bed isn’t really possible
Bedding felt a bit rough and low-quality
The building has old-house quirks: inner door doesn’t close easily and lets light in from the corridor, traditional narrow staircase — steep and not easy with bags
Main door is difficult to open — often takes multiple tries even for someone strong
Occasional ants on the table
With open windows, it’s quite noisy — though that’s typical for Istanbul

I had a fantastic stay at this charming Airbnb in Balat! The space was beautifully maintained—clean, cozy, and full of character. The location couldn’t have been better, with easy access to all the vibrant charm of the neighborhood. The host was incredibly accommodating and attentive, making sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable visit.
It’s a perfect choice for solo travelers looking for a quiet yet central spot to explore the area. Just a quick note: it’s a two-story walk-up, so if you’re traveling light, you’re all set! I’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

Really good apartment for its price. Main cons:
-no kitchen
-wind coming in through the windows
-no iron
Main pros:
-many tourist attractions are near
-the tram and metro stops are also near
-clean and nice apartment
Very good if you want to visit Istanbul for a few days

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. The location is great, in the center of Balat with all of the nice cafes and restaurants around. The apartment was cozy and very clean. Airconditioning is a plus, especially during hot summer nights. The host, Özlem was very helpful with the flexible check-in and check-out and was always responding fast to our messages. Really recommend this place:)

It was a lovely apartment, true to the photos and would highly recommend. It was a bit troublesome with public transportation because we happened to check in on a strike day and the rest of the days the busses were usually stuck in traffic. Therefore I suggest you stay there just use the tram mainly and walk in the lovely area the house is at. The owner is very helpful and always responds fast.

description: This is an entire floor in an Ottoman liberty style townhouse in Beyoglu. The location is very central, walking distance to istiklal street, one of the main centers in Istanbul. There are many cafes, restaurants, bars, and shopping, night life.

reviews.text:
