My home away from home! Fatma was an amazing host and an amazing woman to know! Was a true pleasure to have turkish coffee and chat with her.. One evening she'll also invite you to have dinner in her kitchen, which we sadly missed because we were late at the princess islands!!! :(
The room was exactly as shown in the photos, nicely decorated and cool all day long (absolutely no need for A/C). The kitchen didn't have an oven, but you're more than welcomed to use Fatma's kitchen, and the shower was just what we needed, spacious with immediate hot water..

There was a group of young guys and girls always staying at the stairs outside the building, but they're amazingly respectful and sometimes even helpful (though they didn't speak a work in english), but if you're a privacy freak, they might be a bit of a hassle, as they stay there almost 24 hours, but for 8 days I never notice that any of them would lean and peak in the room, so I believe they're completely harmless.
The neighborhood might seem dangerous or threatening, but for 8 days, we walked these streets day and night, and never felt in any kind of danger - with the presence of a big n well secured police station around the corner you should feel absolutely safe..

All in all, staying in Fatma's apartment was a nice down to earth experience, and is a best start location for exploring the city - 7 minutes walk to Taksim square, 5 minutes from the big service taxi station in Tarlabashi, to take you anywhere you need.

Thank you Fatma for an unforgettable first Istanbul experience - Hope to see you again in the near future :)

Fatma was wonderfully warm and generous. The apartment is located right near some great parts of Istanbul. Although the apartment is in a very poor neighborhood, we did not have any negative experiences in terms of personal safety. There were, however, some problems with the apartment. Every day it filled with flies; no matter how many we killed, more came in each day. There must be a way to seal the place up better than at present in order to diminish this problem. Perhaps this is less of an issue when the weather is colder. In addition, the bed mattress was in a pretty old iron bedstead, but was placed on a wooden board that was nearly broken in two. The mattress consequently sagged towards the middle and was one of the hardest things I've slept on in my life. Finally, the place smelled strongly of mildew/mold. We turned on the air conditioner to get rid of this smell, but it never went away totally. In sum, the price for the place was very good, the location is perfect, and Fatma is very nice person and a great host, but the place came with some very significant down sides that need to be dealt with.

We really enjoyed our stay at fatmas place. Fatma was a really friendly host and we are sorry that we only had the time to meet up with her once for drinking coffee.
The place looks just like in the pictures (although there might be less light coming through the windows - remember this is a souterrain flat).
We would definitivly stay there again but there are some issues which should be mentioned in a review:
- it was pretty cold in the first night since the heating seemed to be broken. But we were able to heat it up using the provided additional radiator.
- there was a smell (and also the previously by other visitors mentioned flies) coming out of the kitchen sink, but this could be fixed by covering it

Fatma was a great host. She (and her husband) welcomed us with some nice Turkish tea, and she gave us great recommendations about the area.
The place is nice, and the bed is very comfortable. It is definitely worth it.
The location is also great. It is at walking distance from the most important parts of Istanbul.

My first visit to the fabled and fabulous city of Istanbul, had an unexpected treat in store when I was fortunate enough to stay in the house of Fatma. To say that she and her family embodied caring hospitality at its finest is an understatement. I immediately felt as if I’d found a second home. And everyone one of the fascinating people I met who were also guests in her home, felt the same way. Their embrace felt like the embrace of the city itself on a personal level. The little roof veranda is wonderful. The adjacent communal kitchen great. My bed firm and comfortable. Priceless accommodation at such a modest price, ideal for this budget traveler.
The location of House of Fatma and her family, in the Beyoğlu district is, to my mind, ideal. It’s in an older neighborhood where people of modest means live and work. Shopping at the humble shops and fruit stands, was just as meaningful to me as seeing the famous historical sites. Her house is only a fifteen minute fascinating walk to Taksim Square, and absolutely great public transportation system from buses, to trolleys, to ferries is all within minutes. Thank you, Fatma, Elvan, Hasan and everyone I met. Great people in one of the greatest cities on our planet.

reviews.text:
Firstly I just want to say Thankyou so much to Safa for the most amazing stay in Istanbul. From the first moment I arrived after a long 18hrs of travel from Australia Safa met me at the apartment and greeted me. Check in was soo smooth and quick. Initially if you catch the Havaist bus to Taksim it is a bit confusing to find with google maps but once you find the apartment it is so easy to get around.
The room I got was not only exactly like it was in the photos, but even better. Rooms are so clean with lots of light. You definitely feel at home. The kitchenette is perfect with everything you need to cook yourself a meal. Bed is very comfy. On my first day I literally slept for 13hrs because it was so comfortable.
The bathroom is very clean also with lots of hot water running making the shower so comfortable. Water in Istanbul is very clean. I even drank the tap water and it tasted great and very clean. Wifi is amazing.
The next day I was all refreshed and ready to explore. Safa helped me with directions on how to get to Taksim Square which is soo easy to get to. It’s literally a 5minute slow walk to get there. Many mini grocery shops directly outside the apartment which are open 24hrs and they sell everything you need from snacks, dairy, grains, teas, drinks to household cleaning products. Very convenient and cheap.
There are many transportation options at Taksim Square such as the metro, dolmus share taxi, taxis and buses to get you to where ever you want to go to. Also there are many food and shopping options all around Taksim Square. Prices are very reasonable, you will definitely won’t be starving living in this area.
Safa’s apartments at the sheriff residence is the best place to stay when Visiting Istanbul. I loved it so much that I extended my stay from the initial 5 nights to 9 nights. Safa is so welcoming and the hospitality that he provides makes you feel like a local resident living there. Any issues Safa gets back to you straight away. i can’t recommend this place enough and I definitely will be coming back to stay here.
Once again Thankyou for the most amazing hospitality Safa, you should be so proud of yourself for the wonderful buisness your run. Keep up the great work 😄

Wow! This place was exactly what we wanted when we were visiting Istanbul! Perfect location ( just enough away from taksim square to sleep well and quiet) but close enough to enjoy. The kitchen worked great equipped with everything we needed to cook dinner. And the bed was nothing short of being great! So comfy and the room stayed dark to sleep well. Safa was 100% responsive with every question we had! Totally worth it!

We suffered certain inconvinience and uncomfortableness during our stay there. The reasons are as followed:
1. We have told Safar bey that we need early check-in one week prior to leaving for Istanbul. He promised that he will help us. Nonetheless, when we arriving at the hotel, we were told that the guests haven’t checked out yet, so we were unable to check-in immediately. When I mentioned the promise of Safar bey, he showed his indifference and insisted on that "help doesn’t necessarily mean early check-in" and "the rule of check-in at 2 pm". Finally, we were forced to stay outside until 2 pm after a 16-hour flight. I don't think this behavior is professional in maintaining a hotel (the place is not a normal flat but a apartment hotel) at all. As personnel working in the hotel you are supposed to know occupancy rate these days. If there are many guests, then you can't make any promise of early check-in in haste. It is obvious that the personnel didn’t receive enough training. As in our case, the promise couldn't be kept, and the attitude toward the guests were so awful. This really annoyed us during our vacation.
2. The main reasons we chose Airbnb for accommodations are that we can cook and do the laundry by ourselves. They did provide plates, glasses, other kitchen implements and a kitchen with basic equipment. However, the plates and glasses were not well-cleaned. The range hood was out of work. They did provide washing machine, but they didn’t provide any washing powder even for one-time washing. It is illogical to buy a package of washing powder for just 3-night stay. As a result, what we used among these facilities are just glasses and kettle. Such being the case, there is no difference between staying in this suite and in a normal hotel room. We could have stayed in a better place with the same price we paid here.
3. During our 4-day stay, we were suffering from flying bugs all the time. There were at least 5-6 bugs flying in the room, especially when we had something to eat, they came and stopped on the food. We had seen them in the toilet, it really disgusted us…
4. When toilet papers were run out, I went to the reception and ask for some more. I was told that the housekeeping hasn’t started yet, so there isn’t any toilet paper. The personnel asked me to come again two hours later. After roaming around the city center several hours, we returned to the hotel. They didn’t response to our request at all. Finally, we paid for toilet paper in supermarket.
5. The communication between reception and guests was sort of problematic. When we arrived some guests happened to check out. They spoke English, but the reception didn’t seem to understand them well. During our stay, we tried to communicate with him both in English and Turkish, it didn’t work. He was unable to understand what we talked, not to mention fulfilling our needs.
In conclusion, due to the situations mentioned above, I don’t recommend this place at all. We have been to Italy and rented a flat, a normal flat owned by a lady, not an apartment hotel. She provided everything we needed so that we felt as if we had been living there for a long time. As in the case in what we called apartment hotels, I think it should have been better than normal flats.

Istanbul.....WOW! It's been an overwhelming experience and unfortunately really to short. We stayed 4D/3N in Safa's apartment which rather felt like a nice and comfortable hotel/apartment with all amenities man need once traveling for a few days. The place is ideally located just a few steps of Taksim square from where all the action starts. We found this a very nice base for all we did as we like walking, we could walk from here to pretty much all highlights in historic Istanbul. One little thing, the internet was not working the entire time. However this might as well be our phones that for whatever reason did not accept the WIFI. For the rest, great, comfortable apartment for a very good price! And Safa, we only met him on the last day, was very friendly and helpful and responsive to all questions we had prior and during our stay! We will definitely be back!

It is a really cosy place, as you can see on the pictures.....very clean with a comfortable bed. Also it is very central located, only a few minutes to walk to Taksim.
When there was something missing or broken, Safa fixed it quickly and friendly, he is very helpful.....well done.
Furthermore you can get the best tea ;) and some really tasty soup in the neighborhood.

I had an amazing stay at this apartment! The host was warm, responsive, and made check-in super easy.
The place was spotless, modern, and exactly like the photos, if not better. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the location was perfect: central yet quiet. Everything was clean, well-equipped, and thoughtfully prepared.
I’d definitely stay again and highly recommend it!

It was a great place and totally as advertised. Lots of amenities close by. It is walkable to Taksim square.
When I told the host that I felt a smell in the apartment, they were willing to put me up in a hotel. I did not need that, but the next morning they cleaned the apartment again and it was fine. I will totally stay here next time I visit Istanbul. The host is extremely friendly and responsive, and the place is clean and cozy.
Wonderful stay! The place was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive. Would definitely stay here again!!

Yine muhteşem bir konaklamaydı,İştanbul’a her geldiğimde konaklamaktan keyif aldığım tek adres.Evin temizliği konumu harika ev sahibinin kibarlığına diyecek lafım yok harika bir insan her konuda çok hızlı yardımcı oldu.Gönül rahatlığıyla kalabileceğiniz en kaliteli airbnb dairesi

Great place one block off the main road near Taksim square. Modern kitchen with all the appliances and dishes you need to cook or for longer stays. Two big air conditioning units that kept the place cool in the middle of the summer. Spacious bedroom with comfortable queen size bed and hot shower with good water pressure. Loved everything about this apartment and extended my stay from 1 week to 2 weeks. When I was there in late July there was some minor remodeling work going on in the building next door but the noise wasn't too loud and they only worked during reasonable hours (10am - 5pm). Would recommend this place and would stay here again when visiting Istanbul.
